me.voicemap.android_1062.creator: AudioGuide
me.voicemap.android_1062.descriptionHtml:
Experience the magic of GPS audio walks, cycles, drives and even boat rides with VoiceMap self-guided tours in almost 500 destinations worldwide.

VoiceMap tours are like podcasts that move with you, to tell stories about what you’re seeing right now. They're produced by insightful local storytellers, including journalists, filmmakers, novelists, podcasters, and tour guides. Sir Ian McKellen has even created a tour.

Why use VoiceMap?

• Explore at your own pace instead of being herded along in a group. Start and stop tours whenever you like, to grab a drink or take in the view, then tap Resume to pick up exactly where you left off.
• Focus on your surroundings, not the screen. With automatic GPS playback, you can just tap on Start and let VoiceMap guide you.
• Avoid expensive roaming fees or fiddly connection issues. After you download a tour, VoiceMap works offline and includes an offline map.
• Enjoy tours as many times as you like, both in your destination and with your feet up, at home. Virtual Playback turns every tour into a podcast or audio book.
• Extend your attention span with indoor tours that help you make the most of your time at a growing range of museums and art galleries around the world.
• With over 1,500 free and paid tours in 70 plus countries, VoiceMap offers huge variety. There are over 100 tours in London alone!

Press:
“High-quality self-guided walking tours...Narrated by local experts, they provide insight into corners of the city sometimes overlooked by regular guided tours.”
Lonely Planet

“We may be biased, but could there be anything more helpful than having a journalist in your pocket when touring a new city? How about a historian, a novelist or just a really passionate local? VoiceMap culls city-specific stories from them all and fits them neatly into walking tours.”
New York Times
me.voicemap.android_1062.descriptionShort: Walks and drives in 500 cities inc. London, NYC, Paris, Rome, Amsterdam, Prague

com.etoos.app.wm_10131.descriptionHtml:
▶워마 콘텐츠가 한곳에
워드마스터 시리즈를 앱 하나에 전부 담았어요.
원하는 콘텐츠를 간편하게 공부하세요.

▶기능을 강화한 단어학습 카드
-북마크 : 마지막으로 외운 단어를 체크해 두면 언제든지 북마크한 단어부터 학습이 가능해요
-예문 청취 : 단어뿐 아니라 예문도 청취할 수 있습니다.
-관련어 : 유의어 반의어 등 관련어들로 어휘 학습을 더 깊게 해보세요
-숨기기 : 손으로 뜻을 가린 채로 외웠는지 테스트하셨나요? '노출 방식'을 '영어만'으로 설정해 두면 한글 뜻이 사라져서 쉽게 암기 여부를 확인할 수 있어요

▶안 외워지는 단어만 모아보는 단어장
안 외워지는 단어는 단어장에 추가하여 따로 공부하세요.
단어장의 단어만 따로 모아 테스트를 하거나 오디오 모드 학습도 가능합니다.

▶총 3가지 유형의 테스트
'한글 뜻 맞추기'는 물론이고 '영단어 맞추기', '스펠링 테스트'까지 다양한 테스트 옵션으로 외운 단어를 더 확실히 점검하세요.

▶들으며 외우는 오디오 모드
단어, 뜻, 예문을 골라 원하는 횟수만큼 반복하여 청취하세요.
'수면모드'를 사용하면 수면 타이머가 동작하여 자동으로 오디오 재생이 중지되어 자면서 들어도 방해가 되지 않아요.

▶실력 진단 후 맞춤 콘텐츠 추천
'레벨테스트' 기능을 사용하면 내 실력을 정확히 측정한 후 실력향상에 도움이 되는 콘텐츠를 추천해 드려요.

▶기기가 변경되어도 학습 이력은 그대로
워드마스터 학습앱은 계정에 학습 데이터가 연동되기 때문에 기기가 바뀌어도 진도율이나 단어장에 저장한 단어들이 그대로 유지돼요.

▶구 워드마스터 앱 구매자 무료 다운
이전에 워드마스터 개별 앱을 구매하셨다면 구 워드마스터 앱에서 발급되는 인증코드를 통해 워드마스터 학습앱에서 무료로 콘텐츠 다운로드가 가능합니다.

[앱 접근 권한 안내]
-저장공간 (필수) : 기기에 콘텐츠를 다운로드할 때, 1:1 문의 시 이미지를 전송할 때 사용됩니다.

at.oamtc.cityguide_30700003.creator: ÖAMTC
at.oamtc.cityguide_30700003.descriptionHtml:
BESCHREIBUNG


Willkommen bei der ÖAMTC App Meine Reise – Ihr verlässlicher Begleiter für unvergessliche Abenteuer! Egal, ob Sie einen spontanen Wochenendausflug oder eine Rundreise planen: Wir haben alles, was Sie für eine mühelose Reisevorbereitung brauchen. Entdecken Sie Top-Sehenswürdigkeiten, Tipps von Experten und vieles mehr für Ihren perfekten Urlaub.
Hinweis: Die App ist auch ohne ÖAMTC Mitgliedschaft kostenlos nutzbar.

FEATURES


» Wichtige Reiseinfos zu den beliebtesten Urlaubszielen
» Individuell erstellbare Reise-Checkliste & Reisekassa
» Mehr als 12.000 Sehenswürdigkeiten
» Gratis-Postkarte
» ÖAMTC Nothilfe-Assistent

DETAILS


» Persönliche Reise erstellen
Planen Sie Ihre persönliche Reise und erhalten Sie alle Infos für Ihr Urlaubsziel auf einen Blick: Einreise- & Verkehrsbestimmungen, Maut- & Vignetteninfos u.v.m.

» Reise-Checkliste & Reisekassa
Die individuelle Reise-Checkliste erinnert an alle wichtigen To-dos vor der Reise und berücksichtigt Reiseteilnehmer, Aktivitäten, Verkehrsmittel und Unterkunftsart. Mit der Reisekassa behalten Sie den Überblick über Ihr Urlaubsbudget.

» Sehenswürdigkeiten
In der Meine Reise App finden Sie neben Beschreibungen der Top-Sehenswürdigkeiten auch Infos zu Öffnungszeiten und Eintrittspreisen. Für einen raschen Zugriff können Sie Ihre persönlichen Favoriten speichern.

» Gratis-Postkarte
In Kooperation mit der Kartenstudio-App der Österreichischen Post können Sie eine Gratis-Postkarte verschicken. Überraschen Sie Ihre Freunde oder Bekannten mit einer persönlich gestalteten, echten Postkarte.

» ÖAMTC Nothilfe-Assistent
Auch im Urlaub für Sie da, egal ob bei einer Panne in Österreich oder einem Notfall im Ausland. Mit dem Nothilfe-Assistenten können Sie direkt über die App die ÖAMTC Nothilfe anfordern.
at.oamtc.cityguide_30700003.descriptionShort: The all-in-one travel companion with travel information, checklist & emergency aid assistant.

그녀희제 | SHEHJ.COM

■ 앱 접근 권한에 대한 안내

「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」제22조의2에 따라 아래와 같은 목적으로 ‘앱 접근 권한’에 대한 동의를 이용자에게 받고 있습니다.
서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있습니다.
선택적 접근의 항목은 허용하지 않더라도 서비스의 이용이 가능하며 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.


[필수접근에 대한 내용]

1. 안드로이드 6.0 이상

● 전화 : 최초 실행시, 디바이스 식별을 위하여 이 기능에 접근합니다.
● 저장 : 게시글 작성시 파일 업로드, 하단버튼 및 푸시 이미지 표현을 하고자 할 경우에 이 기능에 접근합니다.

[선택접근에 대한 내용]

- 매장 근처 푸시 기능이 있는 경우 아래 위치 권한을 포함하고 있습니다.

● 위치 : 고객위치를 확인하여 상점의 유효한 정보를 전달하기 위해 접근합니다.


[철회 방법]
설정 > 앱 또는 어플리케이션 > 해당 앱 선택 > 권한 선택 > 접근권한 동의 또는 철회 선택

※ 단 필수접근의 대한 내용을 철회 한 후 다시 앱을 실행을 할 경우 접근권한을 요청하는 화면이 다시 나오게 됩니다.


2. 안드로이드 6.0 미만

● 기기 ID 및 통화 정보 : 최초 실행시, 디바이스 식별을 위하여 이 기능에 접근합니다.
● 사진/미디어/파일 : 게시글 작성시 파일 업로드, 하단버튼 및 푸시 이미지 표현을 하고자 할 경우에 이 기능에 접근합니다.
● 기기 및 앱기록 : 앱 서비스 사용 최적화를 위하여 이 기능에 접근합니다.

- 매장 근처 푸시 기능이 있는 경우 아래 위치 권한을 포함하고 있습니다.
● 위치 : 고객위치를 확인하여 상점의 유효한 정보를 전달하기 위해 접근합니다.

※ 버전에 따라 동일한 접근 내용임에도 불구하고, 그 표현을 다르게 하고 있음을 알려드립니다.
※ 안드로이드 6.0 미만 버전의 경우, 항목에 대한 개별동의가 불가능하므로, 모든 항목에 대하여 필수 접근 동의를 받고 있습니다.
그러므로 사용하고 있는 단말기의 운영체제를 안드로이드 6.0 이상으로 업그레이드 할 수 있는지 확인 하시고 업그레이드를 권장하여 드립니다.
다만, 운영체제가 업그레이드되더라도 기존 앱에서 동의한 접근 권한이 바뀌지 않기 때문에 접근 권한을 다시 설정하기 위해서는 이미 설치한 앱을 삭제한 후에 재설치하셔야 합니다.

com.ilib.stepbystepsalah_6.descriptionHtml:
Step by Step Salah is an Islamic smartphone app designed to guide Muslims worldwide on effectively offering prayers (Namaz) with comprehensive information. This app provides in-depth illustrations and audio guidance for each step of Salat prayer, along with Salah times and Azan reminders. With a user-friendly interface, it covers all aspects of daily prayers, non-obligatory Salat, and more.

Features:

Detailed illustrations and audio for each step of Salat
Salah times with Azan reminders
Clear and detailed descriptions of each step
Easy-to-use interface
Comprehensive coverage of Salah performance
Muslims' daily Duas
Tasbeeh counter to count and save your Tasbeeh
Customizable settings for gender and sect
Sharing option to benefit others with this valuable Prayer App.

Categories:

This Islamic app divides the learning outcomes into five classes, providing a real-time, step-by-step method:

Daily Prayers: Learn about the nature of Rakaat in each daily prayer, along with prayer timings for all five obligatory Namaz (Fajar, Duhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha).

Occasional Salah: Discover the Rakaat and supplications for Jumma Prayer, Funeral Prayer (Namaz e Janazah), Salatul Tasbeeh, Salat al Istikhara, and Eid.

Preparation: Understand the necessary characteristics related to learning Namaz rules, including maintaining cleanliness, performing Wudu, covering body parts, and respecting prayer timings.

Making up: Learn about the significance of Missed Salah, offering Qaza Namaz, and performing omitted Salat under different circumstances. It also addresses common mistakes during routine prayers.

Timings: Identify the correct prayer timing for all five compulsory Salat based on various sources, calculation methods, and Adhan Sounds.

Tasbeeh Counter: Easily count and save your daily Ziker and create a daily zikar template for each day.

“Step by Step Daily Namaz Guide” app is for teaching Muslims everywhere throughout the world about how to offer Salah (Namaz) with all the required information. It is a complete guide for believers to get themselves comfortable with every aspect of daily prayers. This app helps Muslims to complete one of the most important pillars (Salah) of Islam. Suitable for kids, adults and everyone.
Interpretation of Salah in the Quran reveals four dimensions. Firstly, Allah and the angels do Salah to praise and bless His servants. Secondly, all beings in Creation involuntarily do Salah as they remain connected to God, being created and sustained by Him. Thirdly, Muslims voluntarily offer Salah as a form of worship that belongs to the prophets. Lastly, Salah is acknowledged as the second pillar of Islam.

Purpose and Importance:

Salaah serves as a means for individuals to communicate with Allah, with the ultimate religious objective being the purification of the heart.

Conditions:

Salah is obligatory for all Muslims, with exceptions for prepubescent, menstruating, and postnatal bleeding individuals according to Sunnis.

Invalidating Conditions:

Ignoring certain conditions renders Salah invalid, such as not facing the Qibla, lack of Tahara achieved through wudu, mental incapacity, and offering Salah in inappropriate locations or pathways. However, leniency is allowed for the elderly and ill in terms of posture.

“Step by Step Daily Namaz Guide '' covers Jumma Prayers, Funeral Prayers, Tasbeeh Prayers, Salaat ul Tasbeeh and Eid Prayer, All Daily Prayers. Additionally Significance of petitions are incorporated. Download Now!

biblia.de.estudio.reina.valera_10.descriptionHtml:
Te presentamos una nueva app de la Biblia que contiene la versión Reina Valera con comentarios en español del pastor Matthew Henry. Es la mejor herramienta de estudio que te ayudará a entender la Palabra de Dios.

Biblia de estudio Reina Valera es una aplicación intuitiva y fácil de usar. Además, es una Biblia audio: Podrás escuchar todos los versículos de la Biblia en su celular.

¿Por qué elegir nuestra Biblia?

- Funciona offline, sin conexión a Internet

favoritos para consultar cuando quieras

- Agregar notas

leído

Matthew Henry fue un teólogo cristiano no conformista nacido en Gales, Reino Unido. Estudió teología con su padre y luego en Londres.

Escribió numerosas publicaciones, pero su obra cumbre fue su libro de comentarios de la Biblia: The Exposition of the Old and New Testaments.

Ahora puedes disfrutarlos en español. Su magnífica obra cubre el Antiguo y el Nuevo Testamento y fue considerada por importantes teólogos como el mejor trabajo de comentarios bíblicos en inglés.

Bájala ahora, será tu Biblia preferida. Busca un momento, elige un libro y comienza a disfrutar leyendo o escuchando la Palabra de Dios:

com.bosch.boschlevellingremoteapp_153.descriptionHtml:
The Bosch Levelling Remote app enables you to conveniently control your Bosch Professional levelling tool via Bluetooth® from your smartphone. Using the app, you can control the laser remotely without having to even touch it, thereby increasing productivity and efficiency in your daily levelling tasks.
The app can be connected to all Bosch Professional levelling tools (line lasers, combi lasers and rotary lasers) which contain a "C" in the name, for example:

• GCL 2-50 C/CG Professional
• GCL100-80C/CG Professional
• GLL 3-80 C/CG Professional
• GLL3-330C/CG Professional
• GRL 600 CHV Professional
• GRL 650 CHVG Professional
• GRL4000-80CHV Professional
• GRL4000-80CH Professional
• GRL4000-90CHVG Professional
• GLL330-80CG Professional
• GLL 18V-120-33 CG Professional

Main functions when using a GCL or GLL device:
• Conveniently control your combi / line laser by setting the operating mode, turning your tool into standby or changing the laser intensity to optimize the laser visibility or battery runtime.
• Monitor your tool by checking the battery and device status via the app.
• Check for potential external influences and calibration intervals to ensure the accuracy of your line laser (available for selected tools)

Main functions when using a GRL device:
• Easily control all main functions of your rotary laser such as setting slope, modifying the rotation speed, or putting your device into standby mode
• Benefit from app-only features like setting up the partial projection (Mask Mode) or creation of Profiles to save and apply the setting you need
• Check the accuracy of your tool and have it corrected automatically

We are very pleased to receive your feedback and improvement suggestions for our application. Simply contact us via app.support@de.bosch.com and let us know if you have any wishes or problems – we are happy to help you!

兩種風格隨意切換

沒問題! 使用 Home/End 切換讓你不管從上到下還是從下到上都滑得精彩!

限時圖片讓 PTT 限時動態玩起來

其實全PTT只有我一個人，不信我換個帳號推一樣的話給你看。

你愛怎麼換帳號就怎麼換帳號。

打了一大堆推文卻不知道要推到何年何月?
獨家推文進度顯示告訴你還有幾則推文要繼續推
也告訴你還要等幾秒才可以繼續推
推到一半不想推還可以隨時中斷
直到你離開 PiTT 之前，推文暫存會為了你一直存在!
剩餘推文字數就不用說了，你懂的~

- 發文暫存功能
就算你關機了我也可以幫你回復你放棄編輯的文章!
文章編輯到一半突然想看八卦?
放心退出文章編輯模式去看吧!
我已經把你的文章內容都放在資料庫裡了!

- 發文 Redo/Undo 功能
複製貼上發現貼錯了...

乖，按一下 Redo/Undo 就通通幫你恢復原樣

忘記推了哪篇文章想看又找不到?
經典大長篇卻忘記標題是什麼?
不只記錄看板，你看過的文章通通幫你記錄下來
發過的文、推過的文通通存在資料庫裡

隨時取得專業鄉民分析文通知
不再缺席各種 Live 與實況文
追！都追！

你！你啊！我說的就是你！
在推文輸入帳號前加入 @
隨時召喚鄉民大大參戰

只要有安裝 PiTT 就能即時收到使用 PiTT 發信的新信件

常常用到的按鈕卻藏在更多選項內？
自訂按鈕排列組合配合您獨一無二的使用習慣

★ أهلاً و سهلاً بك في تطبيق مُصحفي - التطبيق الإسلامي المتكامل لقراءة القرآن الكريم ★

- تطبيق مُصحفي يحتوي على القران الكريم كاملاً دون اتصال بالانترنت و هو مطابق تماماً للمصحف الورقي بالإضافة لدعاء ختم القرآن و أذكار المسلم و المزيد من المنوعات الإسلامية و يحتوي على العديد من الأذكار لإدارة وقتك بشكل صحيح و يضم أذكار الصباح و المساء مكتوبة بدون إنترنت

- تطبيق المصحف هو تطبيق سهل وبسيط و مجاني ، لتلاوه القرآن الكريم ، ( مصحف الكتروني ) شامل بمميزات فريدة ( قراءة - استماع )

* و يحتوي تطبيق مصحفي على :
- المصحف المعلم ( التحفيظ بالتكرار )
- المصحف الشريف
- القرآن الكريم استماع
- القرآن الكريم قراءة
- المسبحة الإلكترونية
( سبح الله بسبحة مصحفي الإلكترونية بنوعيها العداد والسبحة، لِوِرد و اذكار المسلم اليومية، مع إمكانية اختيار ثيمات رائعة وقراءة مجموعة من الأدعية المحببة لك من الكتاب والسنة )
- رسائل قرآنيه
- قصص إسلامية
- قصص الصحابة
- أحاديث قصيرة
- سنن مهجورة
- آيه الكرسي ( قراءة و استماع ) بدون انترنت
- سورة الكهف ( قراءة بدون انترنت )
- سورة الملك ( قراءة بدون انترنت )
- أذكار المسلم
( اذكار المسلم اليومية، نوفرها لك من حصن المسلم، والتي يحتاجها كل مسلم بحياته اليومية، مع جميع اذكار المسلم في اليوم والليلة الدورية، مثل أذكار الصباح - أذكار المساء - أذكار رمضانية (رمضان 2022) - أذكار النوم - أذكار الاستيقاظ - أدعية عامه )
- منوعات إسلامية ( أذكار بعد السلام من الصلاة المفروضة - الأحاديث الصحيحة النبوية - الرقيه الشرعيه - أحاديث شريفة قصيرة - وصايا و سنن الرسول - أحكام الحج و العمرة - حقيبة الصائم في رمضان )
- دعاء ختم القرآن الكريم

* إمكانية الاستماع للقرآن الكريم تلاوات متصله بأصوات متعددة لروايات ( حفص - ورش - قالون ) ، و يمكن تحميل هذه التلاوات بنقرة واحدة

* مُصحفي هو الطريق الصحيح إلى الجنة من خلال هذا التطبيق المميز جداً من خلال الخصائص التي تجتمع في تطبيق واحد نخصص للاخوة المسلمين , التطبيق الذي بين يديكم تطبيق شامل و كبير و كامل و يعمل بدون انترنت , التطبيق مصمم بشكل أنيق و طريقة سلسة و سهلة جدا للإستخدام معك دائما

- دعمكم للبرنامج و نشره ليصل إلى الملايين هو أسمى غاياتنا , لعله يشفع لنا جميعا يوم القيامة

- التطبيق مجانا بالكامل , نسأل الله القبول ولا تنسونا من صالح الدعاء , دمتم في رعاية الله وحفظه إخوتي في الله

* ملاحظة : ( البرنامج لا يزال في تطوير مستمر أرجو المشاركة و اعطاء آرائكم و الإبلاغ عن المشاكل و تقييم البرنامج و جزاكم الله خيراً )

eu.tresfactory.lupaalertemasina_580.creator: Tres Factory
eu.tresfactory.lupaalertemasina_580.descriptionHtml:
Versiunea GRATUITA a aplicatiei permite evidenta a 3 masini cu toate functiile disponibile.

Management alerte:
- configurarea foarte usoara a tuturor tipurilor de alerte aferente masinilor, conducatorilor auto sau orice alte notite (memo).

Management masini si conducatori auto:
- gestionarea completa a caracteristicilor masinilor si ale conducatorilor auto.

Management revizii si reparatii:
- control facil al reparatiilor si cheltuielilor pentru ITP, asigurari, taxe de drum, etc...

Management alimentari:
- evidenta completa a cantitatilor de combustibil si a valorilor alimentate in orice perioada.

Usurinta si siguranta in utilizare
- configurarea documentelor se face usor, introducand data de expirare a lor
- configurarea personalizata a primirii alertelor (cu cat timp inainte)
- adaugarea de poze la documente
- primirea pe email a alertelor la una sau mai multe adrese
- siguranta primirii alertelor la timp si scaparea de amenzi
- nu depindeti de un singur telefon

Folosind tehnologia Cloud pentru salvarea datelor si completand sistemul de localizare auto LUPA GPS, aplicatia permite utilizarea si vizualizarea simultana pe unul sau mai multe dispozitive a datelor. Chiar daca va schimbati telefonul sau doriti sa folositi mai multe dispozitive, ele raman permanent la dispozitia dumneavoastra. Fata de alte solutii nu este necesar sa faceti backup la date, acestea aflandu-se permanent online .

Alerte Masina este aplicatia ce permite gestionarea a peste 30 de posibile alerte cu privire la expirarea unor documente ale masinii, indiferent de utilizarea ei (transport marfa, masina personala, taxi, etc), si a peste 10 alerte pentru expirarea documentelor personale (permis de conducere, buletin, atestate, etc). In plus, in cazul in care nu regasiti o alerta necesara, va puteti oricand creea una personalizata.

Aplicatia trimite notificari zilnice pe telefon sau prin email cu privire la fiecare alerta generata, cu pana la 7 zile sau cu pana la 1.000 km inainte ca evenimentul sa se produca (pragurile pot fi modificate oricand). Email-urile se pot trimite la una sau mai multe adrese, in functie de preferintele dumneavoastra.

Aplicatia NU FACE sincronizari/verificari automate de nici un fel cu niciun serviciu pus la dispozitie de vreo autoritate.
TOATE DATELE trebuiesc introduse manual in aplicatie de catre utilizator si reactualizate atunci cand este nevoie.

Pentru a utiliza aplicatia este necesara deschiderea unui cont.

Daca doriti introducerea unui numar mai mare de masini, va rugam sa ne contactati pe adresa de email suport@alertemasina.ro.

io.github.withlet11.skyclock_11.creator: WITHLET11
io.github.withlet11.skyclock_11.descriptionHtml:
This is a clock application with a planisphere. The planisphere shows the current sky at the observation location by setting the latitude and the longitude. You can switch the northern and southern celestial hemispheres.

Standard Time:
You can read the standard time of your time zone. It is indicated by a red point (today's date) as the value of right ascension.

Local Sidereal Time:
You can read the local sidereal time. It is indicated by a small yellow triangle.

Planisphere mode:
You can use as a planisphere. You can change date and solar time by moving the Sun (sidereal time is fixed), change date and sidereal time by moving the red spot (solar time is fixed), or change solar and sidereal time by rotating the ring of date (date is fixed).

GPS Available:
You can use the GPS for setting your location.

Magnitude 6 star:
The all stars that are brighter than a magnitude 6 star are displayed.

Constellation lines:
Constellation lines are displayed.

The Sun and Analemma:
The position of the Sun is displayed with analemma.

Astronomical Twilight:
You can check astronomical twilight time with altitude line of −18°.

Automatic Update:
The view is updated automatically.

App Widget:
App Widget is available.

10-sec ad:
An ad banner is displayed for 10 seconds after lauching the app. No ads are displayed after 10 seconds.

com.eduven.cg.norway_10.creator: Edutainment Ventures- Making Games People Play
com.eduven.cg.norway_10.descriptionHtml:
Are you a wanderer who is planning to Travel to Norway or an escapist who wants to pay a virtual tour on maps? Interested in its people, culture, art, history, cuisine, flora and fauna? Want to get complete Guide for the exquisite places of Norway like Stegastein Lookout, Pulpit Rock, Mount Ulriken, Fjellstua Viewpoint, Dyreparken, Tromso Fjords, Lysefjord, Trolltunga, Vigeland Museum , Drobak. Want to speak like a native in Norwegian or plan your route on the map? If yes, then this Norway Travel & Explore app is just for you!

All features and images in Norway Country Guide are available offline. This Norway Travel App is for the globetrotters who go by the quote, “All journeys have secret destinations of which the traveler is unaware”. With Norway Tourist Guide, Unveil the Veiled places, Connect with plethora of people, understand culture, art and history, Speak with natives in their language, relish the authentic food and take delight in the festivities.

Apart from this, Norway Travel & Explore guides you Why, When and How to visit various places in Norway with precise location on the detailed Map. There are three ways to explore this app - Category view, City view and EduBank favorite places view. Pin your destinations and get the routes on the Map. Not only this, you can see exactly how the places look like with Street View integrated in this app. The app also has a feature to Rate and write Review/Experience regarding entity(s) through Login. Your Travel experience and rating will help the user community.

Norway Travel Guide is divided into the following categories:-

*Art & History Aficionados
*Carnivals & Festivals
*Nature Nomads
*Spiritual Sanctuaries
*Wildlife Wanderings
*Celebrities Cells
*Business Boulevards
*Transportation Hubs
*Cuisine
*Routes
*Commemorative Events
*Entertainment
*Flora
*Fauna
*Sports
*Geo & Socio Outlook
*What's News
*Lingo Sense
*Facts
*Educational Excellence

Main Features:-

* The app works offline. No internet connection needed to Explore!
* Routes not only take you to the destinations but show other fascinating places also.
* Separate section for main Attractions!
* Informs about Airways, Roadways, Railways and Waterways for a hassle free Travel.
* Rove through the Wildlife Wanderings!
* Not only taste but learn to cook mouth-watering delicacies.
* Get updated with live news!
* EduBank is here to save all your favorite entities!
* A phrasebook to learn the basic Norwegian phrases.
* Know facts from the factfile pop-ups!
* Communicate in the Country from your own Language!

Norway Travel & Explore is all that you need to Travel in Norway. The virtual trip is so mesmerizing that you will go for the real one!

We make SMARTY apps, “Simple Masterly Approach to Refine Thinking" for YOU.

https://www.instagram.com/edutainment_adventures/

http://www.edutainmentventures.com/

ru.domopult.sajva.android_894.descriptionHtml:
Приложение «Sajva Service» – самый простой и удобный способ взаимодействовать с управляющей компанией, следить за ходом строительства и получать актуальные новости. Не нужно искать телефон диспетчера, управляющего или другого ответственного лица; отпрашиваться с работы, чтобы принять работника; каждый день приезжать и следить за ходом выполнения работ.
Через мобильное приложение «Sajva Service» Вы можете:
1. Связаться с управляющим компании Sajva Service;
2. Всегда быть на связи с подрядчиком;
3. Получать свежие новости своего дома и объявления от управляющей компании;
4. Передавать показания счётчиков прямо с мобильного телефона;
5. Вызывать мастера (сантехника, электрика или другого специалиста) и назначать время визита;
6. Заказывать дополнительные услуги;
7. Контролировать свои ежемесячные платежи по квитанциям;
8. Общаться в чате онлайн с диспетчером управляющей компании или с ответственным по выполняемым работам;
9. Оценивать работу своей управляющей компании.
Как зарегистрироваться:
1. Заполнить заявление на регистрацию в системе;
2. Передать заявление в Управляющую компанию или отправить на электронную почту.
3. Получить ответ от управляющей компании с данными для доступа.
4. Зайти в программу «Sajva Service» под данными.
5. Пользоваться всеми услугами!
Если у вас возникли вопросы по регистрации или использованию мобильного приложения, вы можете задать их по почте uk@sajva.ru или позвонить по телефону +7(921)313-34-34
С заботой о Вас, «Sajva Service»

com.omning.omniboard.lck1203_31.creator: OMNING
com.omning.omniboard.lck1203_31.descriptionHtml:
If you want to have a meeting with friends or co-workers in real time, the answer is Omni Board!
Omni Board is a presentation App which organizes PC, Smart phone and Tablet in a network.
You can share a document on a PC with several connected(to the PC) smart device without downloading it.
Once the PC screen appears on your device, you can see it in more detail. And anyone can get the authority to give a speech.
Moreover, every smart device holder can do their own handwring works each.
Pens and highlight pens are provided to help you give a presentation.

You can control off-App softwares on the PC with mouse control mode when you need to open a document or play a video.

Do not let yourself behind the class!(or meeting!)
With Omni Board, The Presentation Magician, you can be a leader of where you are in by watching it on your smart device!

- Sharing documents between the main PC and smartphones that you can write on
- Sharing handwritten works between smartphones
- Ability to manipulate PC mouse to control off-App programs
- 4 modes are available; Master mode, Individual mode, Discussion mode and Presentation mode.
- Colorful pens and highlight pens, also eraser are provided.
- Add and remove pages
- Save as P D F and preview function

com.nupuit.ncid_10.creator: xoftit
com.nupuit.ncid_10.descriptionHtml:
NCIDQ MCQ Exam Prep

Key Features of this APP:
• At practice mode you can see the explanation describing the correct answer.
• Real exam style full mock exam with timed interface
• Ability to create own quick mock by choosing the number of MCQ’s.
• You can create your profile and see your result history with just one click.
• This app contains large number of question set that covers all syllabus area.

NCIDQ Examination is the broad-based exam for all interior designers and serves as the foundation from which to build for those moving into specialty design areas. The exam covers a broad range of knowledge and skills that interior designers use in their daily practice. The exam tests only knowledge and skills that protect public health, life safety and welfare. It does not test knowledge that is not critical to public safety, such as design history and furniture styles.
There are two multiple-choice sections: Interior Design Fundamentals Exam (IDFX) and Interior Design Professional Exam (IDPX) (a half-day each) and one practicum section: drawing Practicum (PRAC) (a full day). Candidates must pass all of them to complete the exam. All three sections focus entirely on public health, safety and welfare.

NCIDQ Certification is required for the practice of many types of interior design in regulated jurisdictions throughout North America. Certification enables designers to easily validate their knowledge, experience and skill to employers and clients alike.

Council for Interior Design Qualification, Inc. (CIDQ)
The Council for Interior Design Qualification, Inc. (CIDQ) exists to credential interior designers who have met minimum education and experience requirements and who have passed the NCIDQ Exam.

Disclaimer:
This application is just an excellent tool for self-study and exam preparation. It's not affiliated with or endorsed by any testing organisation, certificate, test name or trademark.

com.ribotask.sense_67.creator: SenseMyDiet ApS
com.ribotask.sense_67.descriptionHtml:
Her er den officielle SenseMyDiet-app, der gør det nemt at følge Sense-livsstilen.

SenseMyDiet-appen indeholder mange nyttige funktioner:
- Komplet madplanssystem med 21 måltider: 1600 kcal per dag
- Kostplaner til vægttabsmedicin: 1200-1400 kcal per dag
- Ny madplan/kostplan og vidensaktivitet hver uge
- Søg i over 1.400 opskrifter
- Opret og benyt dine egne opskrifter og madplaner
- Indkøbslister til alle opskrifter og madplaner
- Sense-venner
- Registrér dine håndfulde
- Planlæg dine spisekasser i dagbogen
- Følg med i din vægtudvikling og dine kropsmål
- Upload før- og efterbilleder

MADPLANER
SenseMyDiet indeholder et komplet madplanssystem.
Hver uge modtager du en ny madplan med en sund håndsrækning til din Sense-livsstil.
Du kan nemt udskifte opskrifter og justere antal personer til de enkelte måltider. Måltider kan fordeles over flere spisekasser for at undgå madspild.
Indkøbslisten opdateres automatisk, og du kan nemt indsætte madplanen i din dagbogs spisekasser.
Du kan oprette dine egne madplaner med SenseMyDiet-opskrifter, venners opskrifter og dine egne opskrifter. Sektionen 'Undgå madspild' viser opskrifter, der kan laves ud fra indkøbslisten, du allerede har opbygget i din madplan.

OPSKRIFTER
I appen finder du over 1.400 lækre opskrifter. Når du indsætter opskrifter i dine spisekasser, reguleres håndfuldene automatisk, så dagens indtag er opdateret.
Du kan oprette dine egne opskrifter, så du kan bruge dem på lige fod med SenseMyDiet-opskrifterne. Appen udregner automatisk håndfuldsfordeling og næringsindhold.
Der er udviklet specielle opskrifter til folk, der tager vægttabsmedicin.

NY VIDEN
Du får en sundhedsrelateret aktivitet direkte i appens ”Nyheder” hver uge. I perioder med forløb øges frekvensen.

SENSE-VENNER
Sense-venner er et socialt univers i appen, hvor du kan søge efter og dele dine opskrifter med de andre brugere.

PLANLÆGNING OG REGISTRERING AF DINE HÅNDFULDE
Du kan nemt registrere dine håndfulde og planlægge forud i appen. Dine daglige spisekasser er tilgængelige på forsiden, og du kan tilføje ingredienser og opskrifter til dem. Appen kan også bruges som dagbog med billeder og noter, så du altid kan se tilbage.

VÆGTUDVIKLING OG KROPSMÅL
SenseMyDiet-appen støtter dig i din udvikling. Sæt dig et mål, og registrer din vægt og dine kropsmål så ofte du ønsker det. Så kan du følge din personlige udvikling via de overskuelige grafer og datavisninger. Denne del er gratis og kræver ikke abonnement.

FØR- OG EFTERBILLEDER
Du kan nemt uploade billeder af dig selv, så du kan følge udviklingen i dine før- og efterbilleder.

SKRÆDDERSYEDE INDSTILLINGER
Allerede fra starten tilpasser appen sig dig og er derfor velegnet til både begyndere og erfarne SenseMyDiet-brugere. De avancerede indstillinger sikrer, at du kan bruge appen på den måde, der passer dig bedst.

Der er to SenseMyDiet-abonnementer med automatisk fornyelse: 1 måned og 1 års abonnement. De giver adgang til alle funktioner og opdateringer i abonnementsperioden.
Hvis du køber et abonnement, opkræves beløbet fra din Google Play-konto. 24 timer inden abonnementet udløber, fornyes det automatisk, medmindre du afbryder den automatiske fornyelse inden deadline. Du kan styre abonnementet i brugerindstillingerne for Google Play, hvor du også kan slette den automatiske fornyelse.

Et køb af medlemskab via web giver adgang til appen og omvendt. Du skal kun købe adgang en gang.

Brugerbetingelser: https://www.sensemydiet.dk/brugerbetingelser-for-sense-appen/

Rigtig god fornøjelse!
SenseMyDiet-teamet

com.simplexi.messenger_2021020104.creator: cafe24 corp.
com.simplexi.messenger_2021020104.descriptionHtml:
OfficeTalk(오피스톡)

설명

오피스톡은 cafe24에서 제공하는 아우토반 그룹웨어 제공하는 무료 모바일 메신저입니다.

OfficeTalk(오피스톡) 이란?

오피스톡은 온라인 메신저 내에서만 가능했던 사내 커뮤니케이션을 보안하여 스마트폰을 이용해 언제 어디서나 메시지를 주고 받을 수 있는 똑똑한 모바일 메신저입니다.
오피스톡 하나면 효율적인 업무를 진행할 수 있는 최상의 업무 환경을 구축할 수 있습니다.


주요기능

1. 그룹웨어 조직도

- 조직도 확인이 가능합니다.

2. 그룹 기능

- 사용자는 자신의 업무 관련 조직을 필요에 따라 생성할 수 있고, 생성된 그룹을 이용해 편리하고
신속하게 커뮤니케이션 할 수 있습니다.

- 온라인 메신저에서 구성된 그룹을 모바일에서도 사용할 수 있으며, 모바일에서 또한 그룹 구성이
가능하므로 온라인 메신저와 동일한 그룹 관리가 가능합니다.

3. 대화

- 양방향 커뮤니케이션이 가능하며, 장소 구분 없이 실시간 업무 조율 등에 효과적인 대화 기능을 지원합니다.
- 온라인 메신저에서 자리비움 상태에서 수신된 대화 요청은 모바일 메신저를 통해 대화 내용을 확인할 수도 있습니다.


4. 쪽지
- 마치 문자메시지로 커뮤니케이션하듯 온라인 메신저를 사용하는 사용자와 실시간으로 쪽지를
주고받을 수 있습니다.

5. 메시지함
- 온라인 메신저를 통해 저장된 업무 기록(대화, 쪽지)는 스마트폰을 통해 확인할 있으므로 업무의 효율성을 증대할 수 있습니다.
온라인으로 주고받은 쪽지/대화 내용은 최소 일주일 단위로 스마트폰과 동기화됩니다.


6. 명함관리
- 그룹웨어에서 등록했거나, 관리자가 등록해 놓은 사내, 부서, 개인 주소록을 이용해 전화/SMS/E-mail 발송이
가능하므로 빠르고 편리한 커뮤니케이션을 제공합니다.

- 그룹웨어에서 등록하는 명함뿐만 아니라 외부 업무 관계자 또한 오피스톡에서 바로 등록할 수 있으며, 등록된 정보는
그룹웨어와 연동이 되어 PC에서도 확인이 가능합니다.

Introducing Hidden: Your Ultimate Stealthy Screenshot Companion

In today's fast-paced digital landscape, the moments that truly matter can often slip through our fingers in the blink of an eye. But what if there was a way to capture those fleeting instances without raising a single eyebrow? Enter Hidden, the ingenious mobile app that is reshaping the way we immortalize memories from our favorite platforms.

Hidden is not your ordinary screenshot app – it's a discreet private screenshot solution designed to seamlessly integrate with your digital life. Ever found yourself wanting to capture an inspiring quote, a side-splitting meme, or a candid snapshot of a friend's antics on platforms like Snapchat, where traditional screen capture methods just can't take screenshots without alerts? With Hidden, you can do just that, all without triggering a single notification. Say goodbye to the fear of alerting anyone; Hidden, the ultimate Snapchat screenshot app, empowers you to capture those cherished moments in stealth mode.

Here's what sets Hidden's screen capture apart from the rest:

Stealth Mode: Embrace the ability to capture screenshots on apps like Instagram, where a regular snipping tool or screenshot app might fall short, without ever sending out those telltale notifications. Your secret screenshot activities remain truly secret.

Versatile Capture: Hidden doesn't stop at traditional screenshots. It takes things a step further by allowing you to snag essential clips directly from your screen. Whether it's a quick private screenshot or an image that requires screenshot stitching for a panoramic view, Hidden has you covered.

Privacy Respected: At Hidden, privacy isn't just a word; it's a commitment. The app meticulously respects privacy barriers by refraining from working on protected apps like Netflix, Chrome Incognito, Tor Browser, and private Telegram chats. Rest assured, your privacy remains intact.

But that's not all. Hidden is not only a game-changer for preserving those fleeting moments, but it's also incredibly easy to use. With its user-friendly interface, you'll find yourself effortlessly navigating through the app, capturing screenshots and private screen captures, and stashing them away for future enjoyment. Take your screenshot game to the next level and indulge in the freedom of capturing moments without hesitation.

In a world where digital stories come and go, Hidden empowers you to decide which moments deserve the exclusive private screenshot treatment and need the finesse of screenshot stitching. Join us in redefining the way we preserve memories – because some moments are simply too good to let slip away. Dive into the discreet world of screenshots with Hidden today and rediscover the joy of reliving your favorite memories, one private screenshot at a time.

You can design skyscrapers that touch the clouds, cozy little houses, grand castles, or even a bridge that stretches across a wide river. This game is all about making your construction dreams come true!

What's awesome about Big Craft House Building is that it's super easy to play. You don't need to be an expert builder. Even if you're new to building games, you can jump right in and have a blast. The game has simple controls and a friendly menu that makes it easy to get started. And the best part? There are endless possibilities, so you'll always find something new and exciting to create.

In this game, players have the freedom to let their creativity run wild as they craft and build their own unique structures. The intuitive controls and user-friendly interface make it easy for players of all skill levels to get started, and the endless crafting and building possibilities ensure that there's always something new and exciting to discover.

you'll unlock new stuff like different materials, tools, and fancy building techniques. That means you can create even more awesome buildings. And, here's the extra fun part – you can decorate your structures with all kinds of cool things. You can add furniture, paintings, and other decorations to make your buildings look unique and super awesome!

One of the great things about Big Craft House Buildingis that it's a perfect game for killing time with your friends. Whether you're looking to pass the time on a long commute or simply want to unwind after a long day, this game is a great way to relax and have fun. And with its multiplayer mode, you can even play with your friends and compete to see who can build the most impressive structures.

As you progress through the game, you'll have the opportunity to unlock new materials, tools, and building techniques that will allow you to create even more elaborate and impressive structures. You'll also be able to customize your structures with a wide range of decorative items, including furniture, paintings, and more.

Overall, Big Craft House Building Block is a fantastic game that offers endless hours of crafting and building fun. Whether you're a seasoned construction pro or a newcomer to the world of block craft games, this game has something for everyone. So why wait? Start building your dream properties today!

no.nordicsemi.android.nrfthingy_39.creator: Nordic Semiconductor ASA
no.nordicsemi.android.nrfthingy_39.descriptionHtml:
The Thingy:52 app is designed to work with the Nordic Thingy:52™ devices.

Nordic Thingy:52 is a compact, power-optimized, multi-sensor device built around the nRF52832 Bluetooth® 5 SoC from Nordic Semiconductor.

Capture, view, and interact with the sensor data acquired from your Thingy:52. Thanks to its simple Bluetooth API and IFTTT™ integration, the possibilities are endless!

Use this app to connect your mobile device with Thingy and gain access to the following functionalities:
- View the current temperature, humidity, air quality, and atmospheric pressure
- Use it as a compass, step counter, or detect taps on any of its axis
- Check the orientation of your Thingy and get live accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer data at a high rate
- Measure the gravity vector
- Trigger programmable events by pressing the button on top of the device
- Control the color, brightness, and mode of the RGB LED
- Stream PCM audio to its speaker, or play predefined notification sounds when events occur
- Stream audio from Thingy to a mobile device using the built-in microphone
- Play programmable tunes in frequency mode
- Using the free Thingy app, update the firmware on your Thingy as soon as new firmware versions are released

For firmware and mobile developers:
Thingy can be flashed with custom firmware, just like any other development kit from Nordic Semiconductor. The Thingy firmware package contains comprehensive documentation, so you can easily customize it to your own needs.
Additionally, we provide an Android Library on GitHub for your Android development needs. These libraries are made exclusively for Thingy, to ensure that mobile development are as smooth as possible!
Learn more about Thingy at https://www.nordicsemi.com/thingy

In WeHunt you will find everything you possibly need in your hunt. This is the app that not only makes the hunt for you and your hunting companions easier and safer, but also much more enjoyable. It’s simply an invaluable tool, no matter what kind of hunt you are conducting.

SIMPLE
Simplify the hunt by creating your hunting ground with borders and map pins such as high stands, gathering places and tracks and share it with your hunting companions.

SAFE
Start a hunt to see not only your hunting companions live on the map, but also participating dogs, for a safer hunt. Chat and send voice messages to each other for fast and smooth communication.

MAP
All hunters want a good map. With WeHunt Standard, you get Terrain Map worldwide. Print the map in paper format via both the app and the web if you wish.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DOG
With a WeHunt GPS, Tracker, Ultracom or Garmin device (accessory) you can see and share your dog’s position on the map while hunting.

AND MUCH MORE
WeHunt contains a number of functions that make your hunting easier. You can, among other things, keep track of the weather and wind on your hunting ground and use the Scent indicator to see the wind from your position. Connect game cameras to the app and get all the pictures in one place, record your tracks on the hunting ground or collect statistics in hunt reports.

Try it today and explore how WeHunt can make your hunt easier, safer and more enjoyable.

____
Note that continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Contains map data from Danish Styrelsen for Dataforsyning og Effektivisering (Kort25, WMS-service and property borders, WMS-service), Norwegian Kartverket, Finnish Lantmäteriverket, and Swedish Lantmäteriet.

com.questalliance.myquest_101.descriptionHtml:
Quest App is a digital learning platform that helps you build 21st Century employability skills. These skills will help you in your personal and professional lives and plan your career journey. By using this platform, you can also get long term support from a large community of learners and trainers.

The platform has 250+ hours of interactive digital content, videos, assessments and more that have been developed by Quest Alliance.
Alongside it also provides a list of resources and extra learning materials, for learners to further strengthen their learning.
The digital content focuses on building 21st Century Skills like Communication, Life Skills, Digital Skills, Career Skills etc and is available in multiple languages.
The app also allows learners to track their progress, performance and learning through a points and reward system. It also allows trainers and learners to virtually connect with each other through a community page. This helps them to support each other in their learning journeys and build a career they aspire for.
Other than this, learners and alumni can also find jobs that are relevant to them through the Jobs Page. Jobs that are available will be updated regularly. Interested learners and alumni can connect with potential employers for the jobs they find relevant.

So, get ready to learn anytime & anywhere, find opportunities to apply and share your learnings & become a 21st century learner.


Home Page - See in an overview of all the recent activity on the Library, Community page and Jobs page .

Library Page - You can now easily access all the digital learning materials here. Under each Subject, you will see many courses. And each course will have multiple lessons which you can either view online or download to learn offline. You can also use the language filter to view content in the language of your choice.

Community Page - This is a safe space for learners and trainers to share learnings, ask doubts, upload assignments and have meaningful discussion. Now you can post without showing your name and edit/delete your comments and posts.

Jobs Page - Here you can find and access jobs that are relevant to you. You can filter jobs based on location, field, type of job and salary range.

Profile Page - You can now do a variety of things in this section.
View scores of your assessments
View points you would have earned by doing a course/ resource or posting on the community page
See the badges you would have earned based on your scores and points.
Edit your personal information and reset your password.
Set/Change your own profile picture or avatar.

Help Page - Here you can view answers to frequently asked questions or report issues faced in the Quest app by filling a form.

Personalised Notifications - You will be notified about the new courses, resources you have unlocked, comments and likes on your posts, new jobs etc. through notifications on the app.

smf.kupiavto_810.descriptionHtml:
Установите АвтоВсё, чтобы купить и продать новые, б/у авто. Объявления на АвтоВсё: покупка и продажа подержанных автомобилей, заказ запчастей и автомобильные отзывы. Размещайте объявления бесплатно.
Обсуждайте вопросы с вашим авто с такими же владельцами авто как и вы. Более 900 тысяч зарегистрированных автовладельцев и более 5000 компаний из авто-бизнеса могут помочь решить вопросы с вашим авто.
Поиск запчастей, услуг специалистов в АвтоВсё бесплатно и быстро. Всё для вас и вашего авто в одном приложении.
Проверяйте историю ДТП авто и другие параметры перед покупкой официально только в АвтоВсё.

АвтоВсё – это социальная сеть, где автовладельцы могут общаться, делиться опытом и помогать друг-другу советами.

Ведите свою страницу: размещайте фото/видео, заводите новых друзей, решайте вопросы с вашим авто, покупайте и продавайте авто, находите запчасти и подходящее СТО, оставляйте отзывы и многое другое в одном приложении.

Полезный функционал каждый день каждому:

- Мобильный антирадар
Полная база камер: статичных радары и мобильные камеры, ДТП и других важных предупреждений для каждого автовладельца.
Отмечайте предупреждения на карте и другие участники движения получат уведомление. Вместе мы можем сделать дороги безопаснее.

- Штрафы
Проверяйте штрафы и получайте уведомления о новых. Оплата с минимальной комиссией банка партнера.

- Страхование
Укажите дату истечения вашей страховки, АвтоВсё напомнит вам заранее об истекающей страховки и оплатит за вас до 20%! Идеальное предложение!

- SOS услуги
Случилась экстренная ситуация: нужен эвакуатор, подогрев авто, выездной шиномонтаж или скажем консультация юриста?
С разделом SOS в АвтоВсё, вы можете легко найти подходящую компанию в два клика. Именно в вашем регионе, проверенные компании с отличными рекомендациями. Не забудьте спросить про скидку от АвтоВсё )

- Запчасти и услуги
Чтобы найти нужную запчасть или услугу через АвтоВсё, вы можете создать заявку - мы уведомим всех партнеров и вы получите лучшие цены на нужную запчасть или услугу.
Также, вы можете не ждать ответов, а самим позвонить компаниям по списку. Мы подбираем именно те компании, которые занимаются именно вашей машиной и нужной категорией запчастей. Удобно, не правда ли?

- Покупайте и продавайте по-новому!
АвтоВсё может автоматически связывать объявления о покупке, продаже и обмене авто между собой.

- Аукцион
Если нужно срочно продать авто, разместите объявление в раздел аукцион - АвтоВсё уведомит всех потенциальных покупателей.

- Мой гараж
Все что связано с вашим авто, может храниться в одном месте. Штрафы, страхование, запчасти, услуги, подать бесплатное объявление о продаже, обмене или же разместить лот в аукцион - все это удобно расположено в разделе Мой гараж.
Просто добавьте ваше авто, вы удивитесь как же вы раньше обходились без этого!

Таким образом в приложении собраны все необходимые опции для автовладельцев:
продажа, покупка, обмен авто, аукцион, покупка запчастей для иномарок,
Штрафы, уведомление если вы получите новые штрафы, страхование онлайн, сбор сервисной истории, помощь в критических ситуациях, мобильный антирадар.

Скачивайте приложение «АвтоВсё», чтобы иметь под рукой весь нужный функционал.

Экономьте время, деньги и нервы!

엠즈씨드가 운영하는 폴 바셋의 공식 주문 애플리케이션입니다.

폴 바셋 소사이어티 회원은 주문 기능을 통해 크라운 오더 서비스를 이용하여 음료, 푸드, 원두 등 다양한 메뉴를 비대면으로 주문할 수 있습니다. 비회원도 애플리케이션에서 메뉴를 확인할 수 있으며, 회원 가입 후 폴 바셋 소사이어티 카드를 등록하고 충전하여 손쉽게 결제할 수 있습니다. 또한, 폴 바셋의 모바일 상품권과 금액형 e-Card를 선물할 수 있는 편리한 서비스도 제공됩니다.


- 홈 : 나를 반겨주는 인삿말, 새로운 소식을 알려주는 새소식 섹션, 빠르게 주문할 수 있는 퀵오더가 준비되어 있습니다.

- 선불카드 : 폴 바셋 소사이어티 카드와 e-Card를 등록 및 관리하고 QR로 바로 결제할 수 있습니다.

- 주문하기 : 크라운오더를 통해 메뉴 주문을 비대면으로 편리하게 할 수 있습니다.
폴 바셋 소사이어티 멤버가 음료, 푸드 및 원두 등 다양한 상품을 매장별 주문 가능 메뉴 및 수량을 실시간으로 확인하여, 쉽고 빠르게 주문할 수 있습니다.

- 선물하기 : 매장 방문없이 온라인에서 e-Card, 모바일 상품권을 구매할 수 있습니다.

- 멤버십 : 폴 바셋 소사이어티 등급 및 크라운 적립/사용을 조회하며, 등급별 혜택을 안내합니다.

- 신메뉴 소개 : 폴 바셋 의 다양한 신메뉴를 확인할 수 있습니다.

- Coupon : 다양한 유형의 쿠폰과 모바일 상품권을 등록하고, 온/오프라인 결제 시 사용 및 히스토리를 확인

- 홀케이크 예약 : 앱에서 폴 바셋 홀케이크를 간편하게 예약하고 매장에서 수령할 수 있습니다.

- 주문내역 / 전자영수증 : 폴 바셋에서 결제한 내역을 확인, 전자영수증을 다운로드 할 수 있습니다.

- 매장 선택 : 근처 매장 찾기 및 원하는 매장을 찾을 수 있습니다.

- e-Stamp : 시즌에 따라 보상용 e-Stamp 발급 및 적립 현황을 볼 수 있습니다.

com.londonandpartners.londonguide_319400.descriptionHtml:
Get the most from your trip with this Visit London city guide, in partnership with Mastercard.


Browse handpicked lists of the best things to do, and discover great things to do in London based on where you are and where you're going.


- Find out what's near you right now from the home screen, including great places to eat and top attractions.


- Find out what there is to do in an area before you go. Just tap "discover nearby" when looking at any point of interest to explore what's worth doing in that neighbourhood.


-Find hidden gems and explore London areas like a local; save places to view offline; and build your own personalised maps to make the most of your visit.


From top attractions, world-class museums, art galleries and amazing shopping experiences to buzzing markets, leafy parks, eclectic nightlife and some of the world’s most famous landmarks, London has it all and it’s all at your fingertips.


AT A GLANCE:
- Unique hand-picked lists of the best things to see and do in London brought to you by our expert team.
- Discover the best of London near your location or near where you're planning to go, including top restaurants, bars and attractions.
- All the key London sights and attractions, including Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Tower Bridge, the Coca-Cola London Eye and many more, as well as plenty of hidden gems.
- Explore London like a local with insider guides.
- Easily navigate using our transport maps.
- Check how the Tube is operating with our travel status updates.
- Find out what’s on in London, including major events, theatre shows, exhibitions and much more.
- Save places to view offline to avoid data roaming charges.
- Receive offers and general information notifications based on your location.
- Plan ahead and create your own personal itinerary by saving all your favourites.
- Search for things to see and do, including all of London’s top landmarks.
- Access and book great deals and offers, directly from the app.
- Find the best routes and directions to navigate the city.
- Location responsive, quick and simple.
- Completely free with no hidden costs.

visitlondon.com is London’s official tourism website. Plan your perfect trip by searching the website for hotels, attractions, travel and events.

com.stn.mobile_player_418995.creator: ST Unitas
com.stn.mobile_player_418995.descriptionHtml:
ST Unitas에서 제공하는 강의를 모바일에서도 쉽고 편하게 수강하실 수 있습니다.
다양한 플레이어 기능을 통해 모바일에 최적화된 학습 환경을 경험해보세요!

※ 앱 이용 도중 오류나 이용에 불편함이 있으신 경우에는 단기별 고객센터에 해당 내용을 남겨주시면 빠르게 답변 받으실 수 있습니다.
※ 모든 '단기 브랜드'의 강의 수강이 가능합니다.

[주요 기능]
1. 내 강의실
- 내 강의실에서 구매 후 수강신청한 모든 단기의 강좌를 볼 수 있어요.
- 프리패스 강좌를 쉽고 빠르게 검색하고 담아 수강할 수 있어요.

2. 강의 리스트
- 다운로드 혹은 스트리밍으로 재생 방식을 선택 가능합니다.
- 여러 개의 강의를 한 번에 여러 개 선택하여 다운로드 가능합니다.
- 다운로드 중에도 스트리밍으로 강의 재생 가능합니다.

3. 다운로드 함
- 다운로드된 강의는 '다운로드 함'에서 재생할 수 있답니다.
- 네트워크 환경에 상관없이 어느 곳에서나 보관된 강의를 학습할 수 있어요.
- 다운로드 중인 강의를 어느 화면에서나 쉽고 빠르게 확인 가능해요.

4. 재생 화면
- 북마크/구간반복/배속설정 등의 풍부한 기능으로 보다 학습에 최적화된 강의를 시청하세요.
- 배속 기능 : 0.5부터 4.0 구간까지의 배속 기능을 지원합니다.
- 영상 재생 : 화면 끊김 현상이 발생할 경우, 낮은 화질로 재생해보세요. 혹은 설정에서 하드웨어 가속 기능을 켜거나 꺼보세요.
- 구간 반복 : 특정 구간만 반복 재생할 수 있어요.
- 북마크 : 강의 내용 중 기억하고 싶은 부분을 북마크 해보세요. 이 후 강의 재생시 확인 가능합니다.
- 화면 회전 : 화면 회전 버튼을 누르면 3가지 방향으로 한 번씩 회전됩니다.
- 영상 10초간 앞/뒤 이동 : 화면의 앞/뒤 10초 버튼을 누르거나, 화면을 터치한 후 왼쪽이나 오른쪽으로 스와이프 하면 동작됩니다.
- 음성 크기 조절 : 화면의 오른쪽 영역에서 위나 아래로 드레그 하면 음성 크기를 조절할 수 있습니다.
- 영상 재생/정지 : 화면 더블탭으로 영상을 재생하고 정지할 수 있습니다.

5. 고객센터
- 플레이어 이용 시, 불편사항이나 문의사항이 있다면 각 단기의 고객센터로 1:1문의가 가능합니다.

[서비스 이용 시, 참고 사항]
※ 다운로드 한 강의는, 다운받은 시점부터 7일 전까지 재생 가능합니다.
이후 갱신을 원한다면, 해당 영상을 재생 시켜주세요. 네트워크가 연결된 곳에서는 갱신이 되어 자동으로 기간 연장이 됩니다.
※ 네트워크가 안되는 환경에서는, 북마크 기능이 제공되지 않습니다.
※ 다운로드 받은 강의가 많으면, 단말 사양에 따라 로딩이 오래 걸릴 수 있습니다.

■ 접근권한 고지 안내

[필수적 접근권한]
- 해당사항 없음

[선택적 접근권한]
- 근처 기기: 블루투스 연결 상태 체크하기 위해 근접 기기 권한이 필요합니다.
- 알림: 강의 다운로드 알림을 위해 알림 권한이 필요합니다.

* 선택적 접근권한은 동의하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 앱 이용이 가능합니다.

* 안드로이드 OS 6.0 이상부터 필수적 접근권한과 선택적 접근권한을 구분하여 동의할 수 있습니다. 이를 원하시면, 6.0 이상으로 업그레이드하시기 바랍니다. 이후 접근권한을 다시 설정하시려면 앱을 삭제 후 재설치하셔야 합니다.


우리는, 우리가 지금 만드는 모든 것들이
누군가의 인생을 바꿔놓을 만한 기회가 되리라 믿습니다.
-ST Unitas

Instantly transform your journey into flyover videos vividly visualizing your travel route. Build your own unique travel profile by adding your places, photos, and stories — capturing memories that last a lifetime. And with just a wink, turn these memories into a carefully-designed hardcover travel book.

Activate our Travel Tracker to automatically record your travel route — battery-friendly and offline, with your phone in your pocket. Write posts about the places you visit, and let FindPenguins take care of the rest.

PLAN YOUR TRIP
Assemble your itinerary, upload essential travel documents, and have everything at your fingertips. Explore itineraries from fellow travelers to inspire your bucket list and effortlessly plan your next adventure. With access to an archive of over 10 million travel experiences, you can see places as they truly are.

TRACK WITH EASE
Automatically track and log your path on an interactive world map. Have complete control over your privacy, with the option to share your live location with a time delay. Add photos, videos, and travel stories, whether solo or alongside fellow travelers. Create an archive of your travel memories that lets you relive your journeys anytime, anywhere.

SHARING BRINGS JOY
Generate exciting 3D flyover videos of your recorded route — free and in seconds. Share your trip with family and friends in a fun, inviting way. Follow other travelers, stay connected with your loved ones, or find inspiration for future adventures.

WHAT ELSE?

“FindPenguins is the perfect network for travelers.”
— Lonely Planet Traveller

“We are committed to creating the most beautiful travel diary app on the market. Design, usability, and honesty are at the heart of everything we do.”
— Tobias, CEO

“In 2013, FindPenguins pioneered modern travel tracking apps and has prioritized development over marketing ever since.”
— Inside-Fact

TELL US HOW WE’RE DOING
Leave us a review if you’re enjoying your FindPenguins app experience or head over to our help page for further assistance: support.findpenguins.com

com.bmw.ConnectedRide_551010.descriptionHtml:
Get the most out of your rides by turning your smartphone into a motorbiking tool thanks to the BMW Motorrad Connected app.

Plan your dream route or import routes as GPX files with our app.

As the app is connected to your motorcycle, you have the option to record all relevant information for your ride.

If your BMW motorcycle is equipped with a TFT display and connectivity functions, simply connect to your motorbike via Bluetooth for this.

Your BMW motorbike does not have a TFT display, but it does have a multicontroller and is equipped for a navigation system? Then simply get the ConnectedRide Cradle and transform your smartphone into a motorcycle display.

Whether you select the "Winding" or "Fast" option, thanks to voice commands to your communication system and navigation instructions that are easy to see on the display, you can always keep an eye on your route. The intuitive operation with the multicontroller allows you to safely control everything without having to take your hands off the handlebars.

Do you want to keep your community up to date? Simply share your riding data and photos on social media.

We continuously develop our app for you – and we hope that you'll stay excited to discover its new functions.

Here, you can find an overview of all the features the BMW Motorrad Connected app currently offers:

#Route Planning.
• Plan and save routes with waypoints
• Motorbike-specific navigation with the "winding route" criteria
• Weather information for your current location
• Import and export routes (GPX files)
• Free map downloads for offline use

#Navigation.
• Motorbike navigation suitable for every day
• Arrow navigation with 6.5" TFT display
• Map navigation with 10.25" TFT display or ConnectedRide Cradle
• Voice commands possible (if a communication system is available)
• Turning instructions incl. lane recommendations
• Up-to-date traffic information
• Speed limit display
• Point-of-interest search

#Route Recording.
• Record travelled routes and vehicle data
• Analyse performance values such as banking angle, acceleration and engine speed
• Route export (GPX files)
• Share recorded routes and photos on social media

#Vehicle Data.
• Current mileage
• Fuel level and remaining distance
• Tyre pressure(with RDC special equipment)
• Online service appointment scheduling

Notes for use.
• This app is part of BMW Motorrad Connectivity and can only be used when connected to a vehicle with a TFT display or the ConnectedRide Cradle. The connection is established wirelessly between a smartphone, the vehicle/Cradle and – if available – a communication system via Bluetooth; the app is operated using the multicontroller on the handlebars. We recommend using the BMW Motorrad communication system for listening to music, making telephone calls and receiving navigation instructions.
• A mobile Internet connection is required to access traffic information. This may incur costs in line with the contract between the customer and their mobile provider (e.g. for roaming).
• Please note that the functionality of your smartphone and the connection to the vehicle also depend on national requirements and factors; BMW Motorrad therefore cannot guarantee that it will be available at all times.
• The BMW Motorrad Connected app will be displayed in the language you have set for your smartphone. Please note that not all languages are supported.
• Continued use of GPS tracking in the background may reduce the battery life of your smartphone.

Make Life a Ride.

com.discipleskies.gpsreset_42.descriptionHtml:
GPS Rest COM is a comprehensive GPS tool set that offers GPS diagnostics, one-click GPS repair, GPS locker, location management and a powerful navigation system.

Has your GPS stopped working? Does it take forever to get a GPS signal on your device? Is your navigation app not responding or is it not as accurate as it used to be?

GPS Reset Com is the perfect GPS troubleshooting and GPS repair tool that will help solve many GPS and navigation problems and allow your device to get a faster GPS fix.

This app also offers GPS repair if your device's GPS was corrupted by GPS spoofing apps that use Mock Location.

Our GPS Locker is a free bonus feature that will keep you GPS on even when the screen is off. Keeping your GPS active consumes battery but will allow you to reopen any GPS app without losing your fix.

There are many factors that determine the amount of time it takes for your GPS to determine your position, but a persistently slow or non-responsive GPS may be suffering from outdated assistance data (A-GPS DATA). Outdated A-GPS DATA can make it difficult for your GPS to determine your location resulting in long delays for a GPS lock. By resetting your device's A-GPS DATA , this app will speed up the time to a first fix. GPS repair may be permanent, though depending on your travel patterns, periodic resetting may be required to optimize performance.

In addition to resetting your device's GPS, you can understand and diagnose specific GPS performance concerns by obtaining the GPS status on the following parameters:

⊕ Time to first location fix, and number of satellites used
⊕ Satellite signal strength and the positions of the GPS satellites- displayed in easy-to-understand animated charts
⊕ Raw NMEA sentence data generated by your GPS chip
⊕ Latitude, longitude, altitude above WGS84 ellipsoid, GPS speed and accuracy of the GPS lock.
⊕ Satellite time (The atomic clocks on the GPS satellites are among the most accurate ever made).


Navigation Module Components

1. Several map layers including
•USGS Topo Maps
•Openstreetmap
•Canada Toporama
•Google Map layers
•Hiking and Biking layer
•Opentopomap

2. Point to point navigation.

3. Real time map location tracking.

4. Map tools including compasses and an assortment of measurement tools for determining distance and direction to any of your waypoints or map locations.

5. All maps can be navigated in heading up or north up always mode.

6. Offline GoTo Waypoint feature for point to point navigation across the shortest distance.

7. Waypoint / Location Management including several location creation tools (enter coordinates, drop a map pin, search an address).

8. Sunrise and sunset reporting.

7. Link the locations you create to the power of Google's Driving Directions service and get accurate turn-by-turn driving directions.

and much more...

* In order to access the GPS chip on your device, the application will request access to your location. Location information is used for the core functions of navigation, GPS diagnostics, GPS repair and GPS locking. If the app is not purchased, location information may also be used to provide meaningful advertising content from our ad partners.

An essential GPS calibration and navigation tool for all GPS and navigation aficionados!

No... no getting deep into formulas or equations... just cool circuit games that take you from the very basic to keep-you-up-all-nighters. You will learn about voltage, current, resistance, capacitance and declare victory each time you win!

★ Challenge yourself with over 100 puzzles
★ Discover 10 essential circuit components
★ Check your homework answers
★ Invent your own circuits in sandbox
★ Get ready to smile as you learn

The objective is to build circuits that generate electronic signals of some shape. You will get to make connections, set component values, and operate switches to solve the puzzles. Circuit Jam will also teach you how to add and divide voltages and currents, work out equivalent resistance and capacitance, and use Ohm's law and Kirchhoff's laws. As you complete puzzles, new sandbox components are unlocked.

Sandbox mode lets you build any circuit you can imagine out of unlocked components. With sandbox you can simulate examples in class, animate textbook circuits, understand how they work, and check homework answers. Or maybe you'll just have a brilliant idea and invent a new circuit.

Essential components can be unlocked by solving puzzles:
• Resistor
• Capacitor
• Lamp
• Switches
• Voltage source
• Current source
• Voltmeter
• Amperemeter
• Ohmmeter

হাফেজী কোরান শরীফ অ্যপটি মূলত যারা কোরান হেফজ করে তাদের জন্য অত্যন্ত প্রয়োজনীয় একটি অ্যপ। আমাদের দেশের সকল হাফেজ ভাইদের কথা চিন্তা করে এই অ্যপটি বানানো হয়েছে।

খুব সহজ ও সুন্দর ভাবে সাজিয়ে বানানো হয়েছে হাফেজী কোরআন শরীফ অ্যাপটি। এই কোরান অ্যাপটি অফলাইন ও অনলাইন উভয় ভাবেই পড়তে পারবেন। আশাকরি আপনারা আমাদের এই অ্যাপ থেকে অনেক উপকৃত হবেন। এই অ্যাপটিতে কোরান শরীফের পৃষ্ঠা গুলো খুবই ক্লিয়ার ভাবে দেওয়া হয়েছে তাই অ্যাপটি পড়তে কোনো অসুবিধা হবে না।
কোরান শরীফের পৃষ্ঠা গুলো পরিবর্তন করতে বাম ধিক থেকে ডান ধিকে টানুন।
কোরানের পৃষ্ঠা গুলো দুই আঙুলে টেনে ধরে জুম করতে পারবেন।
এ ছাড়াও এই অ্যপটিতে রয়েছে চমৎকার ডিজাইন যা আপনাকে কোরান পড়তে আরো ভাল লাগা জাগিয়ে তুলবে।

আপনার কাছে যদি অ্যপটি ভাল লেগে থাকে তাহলে অ্যপটিতে একটি পজিটিভ রেটিং দিয়ে আপনার বন্ধুদের মাঝে অ্যপটি শেয়ার করবেন।

com.learnateso.learn_ateso_40.creator: EM-TECH Global
com.learnateso.learn_ateso_40.descriptionHtml:
Ateso is a Nilo-Saharan language, spoken by the Teso people of Uganda and Kenya
There are an estimated 1.9million native speakers of Ateso found in the Eastern part of Uganda and Northwestern part of Kenya.

In 2011, Ateso was among the languages considered to be facing extinction (Link: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-14530839\) and efforts were being made by some native speakers to save the language.
This became one of the main motivations for the Learn Ateso app because we couldn't stand any relapse of a similar kind.

Therefore the main aim of this app is to teach Ateso to anyone interested in learning the beautiful language.

The app lists English phrases together with the Ateso translations plus the accompanying audio, so that you can learn how to pronounce the phrase right too.

The phrases listed are common phrases you will require in day to day life and you will therefore find them very useful.

** First ever Ateso language learning app .......... (wait for it) ........... in the world (oh yeah) **

The phrases are organized in 6 categories: Basics | Human Body | Clothing | Relations | Calendar | Travel

Each category contains a subcategory or subcategories bringing the number to 9 subcategories.

===========================

FEATURES
Explore Teso (new in latest update) – Post articles, Teso heritage pictures and upcoming events. View and read content posted by others and learn more about the Teso culture.

AUDIOS – Don’t only try to read the Ateso translation of the English phrase, listen to the audio too and master how they say it in Ateso.

SHARE – Share each phrase you learn with friends and family and let them know about your experience with the app.

FAVORITES – Liked a particuar phrase? Mark it as a favorite so you can quickly come to it later.

RANDOM PHRASE – Launch a random phrase on those days when you feel like it .

============================

FEEDBACK

We appreciate your response and views on your experience with the app. This will help us improve the app. Please feel free to send in your feedback and thoughts with regards to the app's functionality, user experience and anything else you feel we should know about.

SUPPORT

If you have any issues with the app and need help. Feel free to get in touch. We are more than happy to help.

============================

The vision is huge and we are working on several app features celebrating not only Ateso but Teso too as a whole, and we are glad to have you as part of this history making process.

com.mycinemahall_101050500.creator: Y Films
com.mycinemahall_101050500.descriptionHtml:
My CinemaHall is a Web Theatre, where any producer or filmmaker can showcase their Feature Film, Short Film, Web Series, Documentary, Stage Drama, Jatra etc. by paying the app. We are living in a generation of digitalization, where people can access any new content through their smartphones. There are many web platforms available today to showcase your work but we are different from them. We believe in providing the full potential to the directors or filmmaker.

Just like a farmer does not always get the required money as he should get for the harvested crops, sometimes a director or a film maker often find it very hard to showcase their film in cinema halls due to insufficient funds. Even if they manage to book few cinema halls for releasing their film, it fails to reach the audience even when the film is good. Audience fails to taste the unique flavour of that film and this results in decrease in the revenue earn by the producer.

Cinema, Stage Drama, Jatra are being made in many different languages throughout the world and whose specific audience are also spread all over the world. Now you can showcase your Cinema, Web Series, Stage Drama, Jatra etc. made in your language to your audience by paying a nominal uploading fees. We don't do profit sharing or pay by the number of viewers because the film is yours and you shall have the right to collect maximum revenue from it.

Benefits of producer/film maker
1. A producer or filmmaker can showcase his film for 7 day period starting from Friday to Thursday just like cinemas halls or multiplexes.

2. Producer or filmmaker will decide the price of the ticket for their film. My cinema hall believes that you should have the right to decide the ticket price for your film. (For example: you can set the ticket price for your films as Rs.5 / 10/15/20/30/50/70 ).
As soon as a ticket is sold, the producer can track it from his back office i.e. a producer can track the number of viewers/ number of tickets sold, from his back office.

3. A viewer's ticket is valid for a period of 24 hours. i.e. a viewer after buying a ticket for a particular film can watch the film over any digital devices for a period of 24 hours.

4. Producer will earn 70% of the ticket price which he has set for his film and My cinema hall will earn 30% of the ticket price. (Taxes , GST & OTP charges applicable)

We are hopeful that our start-up will be successful and it will allow independent filmmakers to earn what they deserve.

Thank you
My CinemaHall

com.mobinet.musictherapy_9.descriptionHtml:
Raga Chikitsa was an ancient manuscript, which deal with the therapeutic effects of raga. Raga, we all know is the sequence of selected notes (swaras) that lend appropriate ‘mood’ or emotion in a selective combination. Depending on their nature, a raga could induce or intensify joy or sorrow, violence or peace and it is this quality which forms the basis for musical application.
Thus, a whole range of emotions and their nuances could be captured and communicated within certain rhythms and melodies. Playing, performing and even listening to appropriate ragas can work as a medicine.(Bagchi, 2003) Various ragas have since been recognized to have definite impact on certain ailments. (Sairam, 2004)

Ragas of the Indian classical music (Shastric Music)
are created according to the deep knowledge of
harmonious consonance between the seven swaras and
chakras. This is why shastric musical compositions are
found to have significant positive effect on the mind-body
system and also have the potential to awaken the
otherwise dormant faculties.

Mobinet Innovations Pvt. Ltd. Is a company who is
taking innitiative to spread Raga Therapy all over the
world by Mobile applications, concerts, website, and also
working with different organisations related to
rehablitation centers and mental hospitals.

uk.co.disciplemedia.thezebraclub_44214.creator: The Zebra Club
uk.co.disciplemedia.thezebraclub_44214.descriptionHtml:
The Zebra Club was set up in 2019 by Jeannie Di Bon, an internationally recognised movement therapist for hypermobility. Jeannie has hEDS, POTS, MCAS and chronic fatigue herself. Together with her 16 years of clinical experience working with the hypermobility community, plus her lifelong personal experience of living with several chronic conditions, Jeannie wanted to create a solution to help the community.

The Zebra Club has been assessed and approved by the Organisation for the Review of Care and Health Apps (ORCHA) - the world's number one technology provider for the delivery of safe digital health. We are proud that The Zebra Club passed with flying colours. You are in safe hands with us.

Jeannie has thoughtfully created a comprehensive programme in The Zebra Club with three main pillars : Movement, Community and Education.

- Movement is safely designed to cater for diverse requirements of these chronic conditions.
- Community - a unique community where you will discover support, positivity and advice from people with similar conditions all over the world
- Education - join monthly live events with THE best EDS / HSD experts in the world. Unique opportunities to actually speak to these experts from the comfort of your own home.

Please note - This is a subscription-based app.

We offer a 7-day free trial, you will need to sign up to access the app. You can cancel before the end of the 7 days to avoid being charged.

Subscriptions are available for £13.99 monthly and £139.99 annually.

Payment will renew automatically unless the subscription is canceled. This can be done in the subscriptions section of Google Play.

We would love to welcome you to join our community. We are a friendly and supportive community for people around the world living with chronic pain caused by Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (EDS) or hypermobility. We also have members who have POTS and ME / CFS. We have a large number of neurodivergent members.

Here we will guide you through a journey of safe rehabilitation and exercise, so you can live your best life every day.

Your journey begins with a series of foundational sessions that set you up for success.

Immerse yourself in the growing suite of classes designed and taught by Jeannie using her proven Integral Movement Method for hypermobility.

Enjoy access to the most supportive group of dazzling zebras to give you encouragement and inspiration along your journey to pain-free movement.

Attend live events from the comfort of your own home.

This handy application presents you several self-guided city walks, featuring the best of the city. It comes with detailed walk route maps and powerful navigation features. No need to hop on a tour bus or join a tour group; now you can explore all the city attractions on your own, at your own pace, and at a cost that is only a fraction of what you would normally pay for a guided tour.

The app is designed to be used OFFLINE so No Data Plan or Internet is Needed, and No Roaming either.

Self guided sightseeing walks included in this application are:

* City Introduction Walk (12 sights)
* Historical Churches (5 sights)
* Glasgow West End (10 sights)
* Glasgow Music Spots (6 sights)

Self guided discovery walks included in this application are:

* City Centre Shopping Walk
* Byres Road Area Walk

The app is free to download. Afterwards, you can evaluate the walking tours - see the attractions and use the fully functional offline maps included in each of the city walk guides, all for free. A small payment - fraction of what you would normally pay for a guided group tour or tour bus tickets - is needed for accessing the walk route maps and activating turn-by-turn navigation functions.

de.danoeh.antennapod_3080095.creator: AntennaPod Open Source Team
de.danoeh.antennapod_3080095.descriptionHtml:
AntennaPod is a podcast manager and player that gives you instant access to millions of free and paid podcasts, from independent podcasters to large publishing houses such as the BBC, NPR and CNN. Add, import and export their feeds hassle-free using the Apple Podcasts database, OPML files or simple RSS URLs.
Download, stream or queue episodes and enjoy them the way you like with adjustable playback speeds, chapter support and a sleep timer.
Save effort, battery power and mobile data usage with powerful automation controls for downloading episodes (specify times, intervals and WiFi networks) and deleting episodes (based on your favourites and delay settings).

Made by podcast-enthusiasts, AntennaPod is free in all senses of the word: open source, no costs, no ads.

Import, organize and play
• Manage playback from anywhere: homescreen widget, system notification and earplug and bluetooth controls
• Add and import feeds via the Apple Podcasts, gPodder.net, fyyd or Podcast Index directories, OPML files and RSS or Atom links
• Enjoy listening your way with adjustable playback speed, chapter support, remembered playback position and an advanced sleep timer (shake to reset, lower volume)
• Access password-protected feeds and episodes

Keep track, share & appreciate
• Keep track of the best of the best by marking episodes as favourites
• Find that one episode through the playback history or by searching titles and shownotes
• Share episodes and feeds through advanced social media and email options, the gPodder.net services and via OPML export

Control the system
• Take control over automated downloading: choose feeds, exclude mobile networks, select specific WiFi networks, require the phone to be charging and set times or intervals
• Manage storage by setting the amount of cached episodes, smart deletion and selecting your preferred location
• Adapt to your environment using the light and dark theme
• Back-up your subscriptions with the gPodder.net integration and OPML export

Join the AntennaPod community!
AntennaPod is under active development by volunteers. You can contribute too, with code or with comment!

Our friendly forum members are happy to help with every question you have. You are invited to discuss features and podcasting in general, too.
https://forum.antennapod.org/

Transifex is the place to help with translations:
https://www.transifex.com/antennapod/antennapod

com.beoneapps.rutadelaplata_11.creator: be One Apps
com.beoneapps.rutadelaplata_11.descriptionHtml:
Localiza en el mapa los destinos de la Ruta Vía de la Plata (de Sevilla a Gijón), visítalos y sella tu pasaporte digital en cada uno de ellos para obtener ventajas y premios.

Con tu Pasaporte de la Ruta Vía de la Plata (#PasaporteRVP) recorrer este atractivo itinerario tiene premio.

Disfruta de tu viaje a través de la Ruta Vía de la Plata y entra en el sorteo de un fin de semana para dos personas en régimen de alojamiento y desayuno en una localidad de este histórico itinerario.

Descarga el #PasaporteRVP y podrás:

- Descubrir todos los municipios adheridos a la Red de Cooperación de Ciudades en la Ruta de la Plata.

- Consultar los puntos de sellado.

- Sellar el pasaporte en los puntos de sellado o bien, a través de geolocalización, cuando te encuentres a una distancia mínima de 250 metros de estos.

El viajero que presente sellos de todas las localidades adheridas a la Red de Cooperación de Ciudades en la Ruta de la Plata recibirá automáticamente un diploma acreditativo y un premio.

Recuerda que este Pasaporte no recaba datos personales y la única vinculación pasaporte-usuario es una dirección de correo electrónico.

Toda la información queda almacenada bajo los parámetros de seguridad y confidencialidad digital vigente, lo que asegura la privacidad de los datos y la protección del propio usuario.

Tu viaje comienza aquí, ¡descubre la Ruta Vía de la Plata!
www.rutadelaplata.com

uk.co.audiotrails.stmagnusway_9.creator: AT Creative Ltd
uk.co.audiotrails.stmagnusway_9.descriptionHtml:
The St Magnus Way app is a virtual travelling companion for the St Magnus Way pilgrimage route in Orkney, Scotland.

It includes route maps, walking guides and a wealth of resources for information and reflection whilst walking along the St Magnus Way. The app makes use of bluetooth beacons placed along the pilgrimage route to flag up relevant resources to that location in Orkney. You can explore the six sections of the St Magnus Way route and its resources in advance, or download individual sections for offline use whilst walking the pilgrimage route.

A pair of headphones is a help for listening to the audio files en route and you can choose how much, or little you interact with the app during your pilgrimage. As you walk the St Magnus Way, you can collect virtual badges from the bluetooth beacon locations, showing your pilgrim's progress along the route. If you show your phone to the curator at the St Magnus Cathedral you can then sign our pilgrim's log book of those who have completed the St Magnus Way.

The St Magnus Way app was developed with funding in part from the Scottish Government and the European Community Orkney LEADER 2014 – 2020 Programme, the Heritage Lottery Fund Mapping Magnus Project, and the Church of Scotland.
uk.co.audiotrails.stmagnusway_9.descriptionShort: Companion app for walking the St Magnus Way pilgrimage route in Orkney, Scotland

appDetails.recentChangesHtml: This update of the St Magnus Way app gives guidance on how to view the information for each leg of the section, and gives access to the downloadable section maps. Have a good pilgrimage.
