uk.co.catalinasoftware.freedomgo.crawfor.creator: Catalina Software Ltd
uk.co.catalinasoftware.freedomgo.crawfor.descriptionHtml:
The Crawfords of London App is the smart way for you to make your passenger car reservations. It’s a mobile App that interfaces in real time with our booking system, enabling you to make, view and cancel bookings, irrespective of how they were originally booked. Our App gives you the option and flexibility of making reservations whilst away from the office allowing a total mobile solution.

You are offered your most frequently used addresses or you can choose a new address by GPS location, postcode, address, train station or airport. You can also save your favourite journeys.

Furthermore you can track the progress of your vehicle on a map – in real time.

We are able to offer a full range of luxury vehicles from the Mercedes Benz E-class saloons to Mercedes Benz S-class long wheel based limousines alongside our range of luxury Mercedes Benz people movers and luxury coaches.

Crawfords are fully operational 24 hours a day 7 days a week and located in central London making it convenient for all London airports and private aviation terminals and via our affiliated service partners we are able to offer a full service in all major European cities and the Americas.

If you require any further information into some of the services we offer and the vehicles we operate please do not hesitate to contact a member of the team to discuss your individual requirements.

If your reservation is a corporate booking or a band on tour and require a reliable and discreet chauffeur driven car service let Crawfords get you there on time Every time!

com.mercury.easydonate_27.descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT NOTE: easyDonate is only for use by charities and requires a SumUp Air card reader and account along with an easyDonate licence.

easyDonate allows UK charities to easily accept contactless and card donations via fixed kiosks or mobile devices carried by representatives of the charity.

Gift Aid details are collected by the app for donors who opt in to GIft Aid. This information can be download from the easyDonate portal allowing charities to claim Gift Aid via the standard HMRC process. The reports also indicate which contactless none-Gift Aid donations are eligible for top-up payments under the Gift Aid Small Donation Scheme (GASDS).

easyDonate allows customisation of the campaign text, charity name, number and amounts on the main donation page. Changes are made centrally via the easyDonate portal so all users of the application from your charity see the same information and donation amounts.

easyDonate works in conjunction with SumUp and requires:

1. SumUp Air card reader
2. SumUp merchant account
3. Licence to use the easyDonate application. For simplicity, licences are provided per charity (associated with the SumUp Merchant) as opposed to per Gmail user.

Your device must support Bluetooth 4.0 and requires an active internet connection (Wifi or Cellular) whilst the application is in use.

For Kiosk use, a managed device purchased from Upgrowth Digital Ltd is required.

Charities not registered for Gift Aid can disable the Gift Aid screens via the portal.

The app now also includes a member fees module (additional licence required).

Additionally, the app supports multiple donation types and funds/projects (additional licence required).

Please contact us via www.facebook.com/easyDonateUK or www.easydonate.uk to purchase a full licence or for a trial licence. Please note, this app will not work without a licence.

To purchase a SumUp card reader and/or register for a SumUp account, please visit: https://sumup.co.uk/easydonate/

easy donate

com.areeb.doobo_535.descriptionHtml:
Go on a new social riding experience, or be the experience host, whatever you choose, it’s time to make new unforgettable memories, friends, and live a little bit more.


Feel the thrill of new experiences

There is nothing as memorable as the thrill of new experiences, especially if these experiences are just an application away. Going on a trip for hours in the vehicle of your dreams, learning about new places, and connecting with new people might be just the moments we live for. doobo is here to take you on a new adventure every day, broaden your horizon, and give your soul a little boost.

How it works | About doobo

doobo is the world’s first globally made platform that connects hosts and guests over social ride experiences of all types. The social ride experience application provides opportunities to enjoy different types of activities, as such land rides, sea rides, and sky rides experiences. The app is designed to bring together supercar and exotic car owners, heavyweight cruiser motorcycle owners, recreational boat owners, concrete and desert drift car owners, jet plane owners, antique car owners, horse stable owners, down to wanderers and hikers with guests that are looking to enjoy these experiences and make new friends.

We’ve distributed our pick-up locations everywhere around your city, please make sure to be nearby to be able to find your host, open doobo app, and connect with your host. Your pickup location is your starting and ending point.


Sign up and enjoy life better

doobo app is divided into two platforms, the host’s platform, and the guest’s platform yet both are intertwined. The sign-up process is a matter of minutes. Both users have to register their information, share the same interests, meet at the pickup locations and enjoy their trip together starting from a 15 minutes ride up to 6 hours ride, depending on the guest’s preference.
• Download the app
• Register with your phone number
• Add the activation code sent to your phone number
• Register your first name, last name, email and create a new password
• Add a profile picture for familiarity
• Tell us more about you and what your hobbies and interests are
• Share with us your date and place of birth, your preferred language and your resident country
• Add your card payment method
• Start enjoying new experiences


Your safety is our #1 priority

We value the safety of our clients, their families and friends. doobo is committed to keep people safe while their adventure excursion, our technology helps us to focus on client safety before, during and after each trip. Rest assured we’ve only accepted hosts whom we have ran full checkups on as well as completed their papers. And please make sure you follow all safety precautions as you ride with us as such: wearing the helmet if it’s a motorcycle and so on)

If you want to know more about doobo, Visit us on the following 👇:

Website: https://www.doobo.co
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/doobo_app
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dooboapp

Or add us on Snapchat👇:
doobo_app

com.rootekstudio.repeatsandroid_2080013.creator: Rootek Studio
com.rootekstudio.repeatsandroid_2080013.descriptionHtml:
The Repeats app is a smart learning app.

How does it work?
Sets containing questions and answers on a given topic (e.g. English vocabulary) are added to the application. The application then sends out notifications with the questions from the set at a user-specified frequency.

What are the benefits of this?
Thanks to the use of this method of learning, during the day you prepare for a test and at the same time you do not waste time when wrapping from books/notebook.

How can I customize the sending of notifications to my needs?
You can set the days of the week and notification times for each set.

How can I add sets?
Sets can be added in 4 ways:
- Create a new set: you can manually enter your set into Repeats based on your book or lesson notes. Don't forget to share it with others ;)
- Create set from photo: Take a picture of the dictionary (or select it from gallery) and create a set from words detected from photo
- Load set from file: you can load set from the .zip file sent to you (previously generated by Repeats application)
- Download kits from the Repeats Community: Search for sets in the public Repeats database

What are the other features of the application?
In addition to sending notifications, the application also includes a Fast learning module. Thanks to advanced algorithms, the application, based on previous answers, selects questions that were previously answered incorrectly many times and creates a test from them.

A very useful feature of the application is Read Aloud. Repeats will read the contents of the selected set. You can adjust the reading speed at any time.

Thanks to the statistics you can keep track of your learning progress.

You can also set a test reminder to remind you about the test a few days before.

If you do not want the application to check punctuation marks or accents when checking your answer, go to the set settings and check the Ignore special characters option.

You can add photo and additional answers to the question.

Built-in search engine allows you to quickly find the answer to the question in your database.

If you are changing your phone or resetting it, you can back up your sets. You'll find this option in the app's settings.

You have two themes to choose from: light and dark (default).

appDetails.recentChangesHtml:
The most important changes in version 2.8:
- Test reminders

- New look for statistics

- A new, more intuitive way to configure notifications

- Default ignoring upper/lower case letters during response

com.fc2.blog9.zze128.poffxtwinkle_5.descriptionHtml:
タッチパネル操作で端末をスリープ（電源オフ）にするアプリ。Android 9.0以降をお使いの場合は指紋認証に対応します。

特徴
✓タッチ操作でスリープ（指紋認証に完全対応）
✓操作中のアプリ画面を維持したままスリープにできます。
✓安全・安心　ルート権限不要、広告表示もありません

こんな人にお勧め
- 電源スイッチが押しにくい場合
- 電源スイッチが壊れるのが心配な提督さん
- 指紋認証に対応したスリープツールをお探しの司令官

操作方法
1 アプリを起動して「はい」をタップします
2 通知ドロワーから夕立の通知をタップするとスリープになります

初回実行時に端末管理アプリ（デバイス管理者）の設定画面を表示しますので有効にしてください。この操作は一度だけでOKです。管理アプリ（デバイス管理者）はスリープする為に必要な設定です（画像参照）。
※Android 9.0以上でユーザー補助サービスを使用する場合は、デバイス管理者の設定は必要ありません。
※HOME画面にショートカットアイコンからスリープさせることもできます。

アンインストール・他
-【重要】 アンインストールするには管理アプリ（デバイス管理者）の解除が必要です。
機種によって名称が異なりますが、端末管理者、端末管理アプリのような名前で、セキュリティ関連の設定にあります。
アンインストールは、”アプリドロワー”から行ってください。設定の解除とアンインストールを同時に行うことができます。
アプリドロワーからアンインストールが出来ない場合は、メニューからヘルプ（支援要請）を参照してください。

- 指紋認証をご利用の場合は、スリープ解除時にPIN等の入力が必要です。詳しくは支援要請（HELP）を行ってください。Android 9.0以上なら指紋認証に対応する事も可能です。
- ゲーム等一部のアプリでは表示した状態でスリープに出来ません。HOME画面に戻してからスリープしてください。

サポート
サポートが必要な場合は、メールまたはTwitter(@NewExperienceX) までお願いします。レビューから質問された場合、Google playの仕組み上回答できない場合があります。
※メールでのお問い合わせの場合、こちらからのメールを受信できるようにしてください。

謝辞
本アプリ制作において使用した素材、参考にしたサイト様です。すばらしい素材・情報のご提供ありがとうございます。
- アイコン画像 木口様（@Kiguchi1902） / 艦これアイコンまとめ http://togetter.com/li/545148

kr.ac.jbnu.ch_3634.descriptionHtml:
전북대 총학생회 앱은 그 동안 접근성이 낮았던 제휴업체 등의 총학생회의 사업들과 제54대 총학생회의 일부 공약들을 앱에 탑재해 총학생회의 사업들에 대한 학우님들의 접근성을 높여줍니다.

1. 제휴업체
- 제휴업체의 위치, 목록, 제휴 혜택 및 대표메뉴와 가격, 연락처 및 영업시간을 알아보기 쉽게 정렬하여 표시합니다.

2. 공지사항
- 총학생회 및 일부 단과대학의 공지사항들을 실시간으로 받아오며, 공지사항 업로드 시 알림을 표시하여 사용자에게 공지사항 업로드를 알립니다.

3. 전대 청원제도
- 총학생회 및 전북대학교에 대한 개선사항들을 전대 청원제도에 업로드하시면, 누적 동의자 수에 따라 해당 청원이 채택되며, 채택된 청원은 대학본부 및 중앙운영위원회와 협의하여 학우님들께 답변을 드립니다.

4. 캠퍼스 맵
- 학우님들께서 찾아가기 쉽도록 전북대학교 내 주요 단과대학의 위치 및 각종 편의시설들의 위치를 지도에 표시하였습니다.

5. 스포츠 용병 제도
- e스포츠를 포함한 각종 스포츠들의 참여자를 손쉽게 구인하고, 지원할 수 있습니다.

6. 합격자 수기 공유
- 합격자 수기 공유는 각종 자격증 등의 시험들에 대한 합격자들의 후기 및 각종 공부법을 공유하는 플랫폼입니다.

7. 실시간 공약 이행률
- 그 동안 분기별로 업로드되던 일부 단과대학 및 총학생회의 공약 이행률을 실시간으로 카테고리별로 나눠 표기합니다.

8. 대여사업 물품 잔여수량 확인
- 그 동안 쉽게 알 수 없었던 총학생회 및 일부 단과대학의 대여사업 물품을 실시간으로 잔여수량 및 전체수량을 표시합니다.
또한, 대여기록 표시를 통해 대여기록 및 반납여부, 반납일을 확인하실 수 있습니다.

9. 피드백 허브
- 전북대학교 내 시설 및 총학생회의 사업들에 대한 피드백이 있나요?
피드백 허브에 학우님들의 멋진 의견을 펼쳐보세요.
총학생회가 학우님의 피드백에 직접 답변해드리며, 또한 해당 피드백은 총학생회 및 관련 부서에 전달하여 해결될 수 있도록 하겠습니다.

hicaltech87.homesteptest.threeminutesfit.creator: Hicaltech 87
hicaltech87.homesteptest.threeminutesfit.descriptionHtml:
Home Step Test aims is to monitor the development of the athlete's cardiovascular system.

Required Resources
To conduct this test, you will require:

A 12-inch high bench or step
A Stopwatch (Available in This App)
Metronome or cadence CD (Available in This App)
Heart rate monitor (optional)
Assistant
How to conduct the test
This test requires the athlete to step up and down, one foot at a time, onto the step or bench for 3 minutes and to maintain a steady 24 steps/minute

The athlete warms up for 10 minutes
The assistant sets the metronome to a 24 steps/minute pace (Watch The Metronome Animation Video in Start Test Menu)
The assistant gives the command "GO" and starts the stopwatch
The athlete steps up and down, one foot at a time, onto the step or bench at a steady 24 steps/minute for 3 minutes
The assistant ensures the athlete maintains the required 24 steps/minute pace
The assistant stops the test after 3 minutes and immediately records the athlete's heart rate (bpm) [Just Count in 30 Seconds and The Result is automatically in beats per minutes]

Home Step Test Tutorial Application Use
To conduct the test, please choose start test menu

Follow the beats sound that comming up on the video and start doing step test

After test, immediately take immediately the athlete's heart rate in 30 seconds then will automatically convert to bpm

Fill the heart rate after the test to heart rate cell don't forget to insert your age and choose your gender before press the process button

Don't forget to fill up the name, age, and choose a gender to save your data

After the user enters the data, please click the PROCESS button to find out the results of fitness level.

If you want to store data that has been calculated, please click SAVE button.

If you want to delete data that has been entered on the data input page please click CLEAR button.

If you want to see the data that has been saved before please click the DATA button.

com.excelatlife.moodlog_240010001.creator: Excel At Life
com.excelatlife.moodlog_240010001.descriptionHtml:
“What triggers my stress?”

“When am I not as depressed?”

“Do certain foods make my pain worse?”

“Are my headaches associated with certain places or people?”

“Are my moods worse during my menstrual cycle?”

“Is my treatment effective?”

“Is my athletic performance enhanced by certain moods?”

All these questions and more can be answered by the Mood Log.

The Mood Log not only gives you a place to record your daily moods and/or symptoms but it will provide an analysis of how different activities or events can impact your moods or symptoms. Not only that, but as the mood logs are fully customizable you can use the logs to track anything you want.

Why is Excel At Life's Mood Log Better than Simply Recording Moods?
Many mood trackers are available. But that is all they do. You can see how your moods fluctuate but unless you are good at finding patterns (without recall bias) it is difficult to know the triggers or associated events.

Excel At Life's Mood Log allows you to record your moods in 15 minute intervals throughout the day. Moods can fluctuate considerably with different activities so a simple once a day mood tracker is not enough to help you understand the changes in your mood.

The Mood Log lets you rate moods or symptoms (or anything that occurs frequently and can be assessed on a 10 point scale). In addition, you can select actions, activities, or events that were occurring at the same time.

The analysis feature of the app will tell you which moods occurred with these actions and the average rating for each mood.

The other feature that is unique about the Mood Log is that it is fully customizable:
1) Choose moods or symptoms to track. Although the Mood Log provides a list of basic moods, you can also add any moods or symptoms you want to track.
2) Create your own high/low labels. The moods or symptoms or assessed on a 10 point scale from low to high. However, if some other label makes more sense for what you are trying to track, you can change the label.
3) Choose actions, activities, or events. The Mood Log comes with a list of actions from which you can select. However, you can include your own.

An Important Note to Most Effectively Use the Analysis Feature
The analysis can only be as accurate as the data. For the most effective use of the mood log, the following is necessary:
1) Lots of ratings. When using averages, the accuracy increases with more data.
2) Consistent ratings. The closer you are to keeping daily ratings the more accurate your analysis will be.
3) Define the ratings clearly. Be sure you have clearly specified what your ratings mean.

Determine What Impacts Your Moods
When you determine that certain actions or events impact your moods, you are then able to do something to change the situation.

Analyze the Contributors to Physical Symptoms
It has been known for a long time that reporting of physical symptoms is affected by what is known as a “recall bias.” As a result, people's reporting of past pain is frequently inaccurate . The Mood Log can help you see associations between your symptoms and certain situations. By keeping a daily log you are less likely to be influenced by recall bias.

Treatment
The Mood Log has unlimited potential as an aid to therapy. You can track different therapeutic interventions and how your moods or symptoms are affected.

Using the Graph Feature
To make the Mood Log even more effective, the graph feature allows you to view different moods and actions together. This allows you to analyze patterns based on multiple actions. For instance, you can see how your mood varies when you are doing something alone or with someone.

How this mood and symptom log can be used to understand patterns is limited only by your inventiveness when customizing. The more you record in it the more it can help you understand yourself so as to make effective changes in your life.
com.excelatlife.moodlog_240010001.descriptionShort: Track and analyze your moods and symptoms to change your life.
com.excelatlife.moodlog_240010001.title: Mood Log Tracker with Analysis

com.ymaa.waterstyle_6.creator: YMAA
com.ymaa.waterstyle_6.descriptionHtml:
Updated for Android OS 11!

Stream or download this rare lesson on Water Style kung fu, or Liu He Ba Fa. This is an internal martial art style, similar to tai chi, that develops your Qi (energy) beyond normal. One IAP unlocks the entire contents of this video lesson with Master Helen Liang.

Water style is the next step in your internal-arts journey. Like tai chi, Water style is a popular internal martial art known for centuries to transform your health. In this follow-along video, Master Helen teaches a basic understanding of the 66-movement Water-style form, explaining the correct movements with the martial and energetic purposes of each movement.

Water style, also known as Liu He Ba Fa, emphasizes smooth, flowing movements that alternate between slow and fast, soft and hard, like the transformation of water between solid, liquid, and steam. The movements resemble floating clouds and flowing water, sometimes calm, sometimes surging. The student learns how the body generates force through alignment (kinetic energy), and how to channel qi (intrinsic energy) into powerful movements, resulting in improved circulation.
Master Helen guides you with
• Water-style form walk-through
• Water style step-by-step instruction
• Clear explanation of energetic principles
Water style is said to have the firm softness and fluidity of tai chi, the intense power of xingyi, and the evasive coiling of bagua. Learning and mastering this form offers a beautiful way to refine your mind (xin) and spirit (yi).
(Water style is recommended as a next step for those with some experience with other internal martial arts, such as tai chi, bagua, and xingyi).

Like Tai Chi, Water Style relaxes the mind and body deeply, a key to maintaining and improving health. Your natural healing abilities are most effective when you are calm and centered. Regular practice can benefit your strength, flexibility, bone density, and muscle mass. The low-impact exercise has been shown to improve symptoms of depression and insomnia and promote the healing of chronic conditions. This mind-body art is an excellent way to relieve stress, lower your blood pressure, and develop a positive attitude toward life.

Thank you for downloading our free app! We are striving to make the best possible video apps available.

Sincerely,
The team at YMAA Publication Center, Inc.
(Yang’s Martial Arts Association)

DoseControl App supports relatives in their home care for their older loved ones with chronic illnesses with safe and correct medication intake.

Make sure that your loved ones are taking medication in the right dose and at the right time and you will be informed about it with the help of our app around the clock!

DoseControl App works only with supported pill dispensers from DoseControl, which have a built-in Bluetooth module. If you are not sure whether your device works with the app, please contact customer service at info@dosecontrol.de.

- Connection to a DoseControl pill dispenser via Bluetooth interface

- Daily and monthly intake overview of taken or missed doses in a clear calendar

- List of the alarms and information about the time of the next alarm

- Remote monitoring via email notifications of taken and missed doses

Encontrarás también información acerca de los beneficios laborales (gratificación, CTS y liquidación) para solucionar tus dudas.

com.meuradinho.radio14415_561.creator: Meu Radinho
com.meuradinho.radio14415_561.descriptionHtml:
A Rádio Rio de Janeiro é uma emissora de rádio brasileira sediada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Opera em 1400 kHz em AM. É uma emissora com conteúdo dedicado ao espiritismo.

A atual direção comanda a Rádio Rio de Janeiro desde 1971. Foi quando Geraldo de Aquino criou a Fundação Cristã-Espírita Cultural Paulo de Tarso (Funtarso), em 5 de fevereiro daquele ano.

De acordo com a página da emissora, Geraldo atua em rádio desde a década de 1930, junto com João Pinto de Souza na antiga Rádio Clube do Rio de Janeiro no comando do programa "Hora Espiritualista". A atração foi rebatizada como “Hora Espiritualista João Pinto de Souza” com a morte do apresentador do programa. Em 1948, Geraldo idealizou o programa “Meditação e Evocação da Ave-Maria”, atração que ainda faz parte da grade de programação da Rádio Rio de Janeiro.

Com o espaço conquistado nos meios de comunicação, Geraldo de Aquino passou liderar uma campanha para que os espíritas tivessem uma emissora de rádio, o que aconteceu em 2 de agosto de 1971 com a aquisição da Rádio Rio de Janeiro. Geraldo esteve à frente da Funtarso até 1984, ano de sua morte.

Sua programação é composta de atrações jornalísticas, culturais e religiosas. O sustento da estação provém de doações e publicidade, desde que não atente contra o código de ética da emissora.

ATENÇÃO: Não temos filiação alguma com a rádio, nem com seus proprietários. Somos um aplicativo independente desenvolvido por fãs dessa emissora.

com.rsmnm.driver_26.creator: Appmaisters
com.rsmnm.driver_26.descriptionHtml:
As an Independent Business Owner (IBO), you are growing your Company through recruitment. Each member that becomes part of your network is your Downline and you receive a percentage of their gross earnings.

However, to be eligible to receive the commissions from your Downline you must provide the RideShare service for a required number of part-time hours each week. Yet, as an IBO with RideShare, you will always receive 70% of the gross fare per transaction as soon as the charge is processed.

Since we hold in esteem the commitment of Veterans and Academics, such as teachers and students, the required hours for establishing commission eligibility are greatly reduced.

RideShare Drivers earn commission by working the required part-time hours and as the number of their direct recruits goes up, the required hours for earning commission goes down until it reaches zero. Clients have the lowest fares in the market that are unchanging, and businesses will have an abundance of product and service requests because more people in society will have greater amounts of disposable income.

How it all works:
• IBO/ Driver recruits Driver 1.
• Driver earns 2.25% as commission from their 1st tier downline, Driver 1.
◦ RideShare receives the 2.75% that remains.

• Driver 1 recruits Driver 1a to become a member of the platform.
• Driver 1 earns 2.25% as commission from their 1st tier, Driver 1a.
• Driver earns 1.5% as commission from their 2nd tier, Driver 1a.
◦ RideShare receives the 1.25% that remains.

• Driver 1a recruits Driver 1b to become a member of the platform.
• Driver 1a earns 2.25% as commission from their 1st tier, Driver 1b.
• Driver 1 earns 1.5% as commission from their 2nd tier, Driver 1b.
• Driver earns 0.8% as commission from their 3rd tier, Driver 1b.
◦ RideShare receives the 0.45% that remains.

• Driver 1b recruits Driver 1c to become a member of the platform.
• Driver 1b earns 2.25% as commission from their 1st tier, Driver 1c.
• Driver 1a earns 1.5% as commission from their 2nd tier, Driver 1c.
• Driver 1 earns 0.8% as commission from their 3rd tier, Driver 1c.
• Driver earns 0.45% as commission from their 4th tier, Driver 1c.
◦ RideShare receives the 0% that remains.

Financial Breakdown:
Let us use $100 as an example:
$100 earned – 30% deduction = $70 net amount

The 30% deduction breakdown:
5% = tiered payout
25% = RideShare deduction

Upline commissions for an IBO (a.k.a. Driver) from Downline:
1st tier: $100 – 2.25% = $2.25
2nd tier: $100 – 1.5% = $1.50
3rd tier: $100 – 0.8% = $0.80
4th tier: $100 – 0.45% = $0.45

*In this example, if one person from each tier makes $100, then the IBO as the Upline receives $5 as a commission from their 4 tier Downline. If the commission eligibility requirement is not met during the work week, then the commission is passed to RideShare.

The 2 Main Components
• Upline - The person or business entity that is recruiting and establishing a network is the Upline and receives percentage earnings from their Downline.
• Downline - The people that have been recruited are the Downline and pay a percentage of their earnings to the Upline members.

Disclosure

The Drivers' 5% Revenue Sharing Plan is an exciting opportunity that rewards you for selling services and for sponsoring other participants who do the same. Although the opportunity is unlimited, individual results will vary depending on commitment levels and sales skills of each participant (referred to as an “Independent Business Owner”).

الحافظ أبو بكر، عبد الله بن محمد بن عبيد بن سفيان بن قيس البغدادي القرشي مولاهم من موالي بني أمية (208 هـ - 281 هـ) الملقب بـ ابن أبي الدنيا (وقد طغى لقبه على اسمه حتى اشتهر به)؛ ولد الحافظ أبو بكر في مدينة بغداد، في أوائل القرن الثالث الهجري سنة ثمان ومائتين (208 هـ). هو مؤرخ ومؤدب عربي، أدّب المعتضد العباسي وابنه المكتفي بالله.
قال عنه الحافظ ابن كثير - رحمه الله - في البداية والنهاية: " المشهور بالتصانيف الكثيرة، النافعة، الشائعة، الذائعة في الرقائق وغيرها، وكان صدوقاً، حافظاً، ذا مروءة ".

com.ideabytes.dgsms.midland_22.descriptionHtml:
Truck and Courier Drivers - Quick, simple TDG placarding compliance with DGMobi.
- Avoid infractions and speed up inspections.
- Application calculates the placarding required for the loads one places on the truck based on UN Numbers, Class, Packing group, weight and rules.
- At each pick-up and drop-off enter or remove the load, and DGMobi recalculates placarding.
- Displays 3 levels of placarding non-optimized, semi-optimized and Optimized. Gives you the driver a decision as to what placarding is acceptable on the truck
- ERG 2016 is available at your fingertips – no need to thumb through manuals in an emergency
- Multi-lingual interface – English, French and Spanish
- Compliant across NAFTA for all loads Originating in Canada
- Class 1 segregation included. DANGER placard optimization included.
- SP 23 – Toxic by Inhalation – covered
- Speeds up HAZMAT inspections and avoid HAMZAT infractions and maintain safety points!
- System has more than a million loads verified – without a single infraction.
- Drivers, don’t leave home without it!

AG PCNP Adult Primary Care MCQ Exam Prep

Key Features of this APP:
• At practice mode you can see the explanation describing the correct answer.
• Real exam style full mock exam with timed interface
• Ability to create own quick mock by choosing the number of MCQ’s.
• You can create your profile and see your result history with just one click.

The patient population of focus for the AGPCNP includes adolescents, young to middle age adults and older adults. Our AGPCNP graduates practice in community and hospital-based primary care clinics, in patient’s homes, in sub-acute/skilled nursing facilities, and in long-term care settings. The AGPCNP works in collaboration with other members of the health care team.

AGPCNP specialty coursework and supervised clinical experiences emphasize:
patient-centered, evidence-based practice
interprofessional, team-based clinical training
advocacy for vulnerable, high-risk adult populations
nursing leadership in improving the quality and safety of health care systems
AGPCNP specialty track graduates will also be eligible for national board certification through the American Nurses' Credentialing Center (ANCC) and the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners (AANP).

Enjoy the app and pass your Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner, AGPCNP, AANP, AANC, DCHS exam effortlessly!

com.kuwagata.sifi_fridge_2.creator: 中村木工所２代目
com.kuwagata.sifi_fridge_2.descriptionHtml:
Enjoy food management as like survive in post apocalypse world.
In reality, you play by managing food in the real world.
Since it is a setting of a savage world, it will be a matter of how to store and manage valuable food.

There are many ways to play...
- You can look at the list of your food registered in the app with the app and grin.
- You can reduce the time and effort of cooking by intensively making a lot of food with a long shelf life.
- Or conversely, by making as many dishes as possible and recording them, you can score how many foods you have created.

Enjoy the "score" of the app
It counts as you plan to store and eat food
However, if you throw away the food, it will also be counted.
Also, by concentrating as much as possible on one day and storing and cooking food that will last for a long time
You can see numerically whether you could reduce the time and effort you spent on cooking in January.
Of course, if you like cooking, you don't have to worry about this number.
Anyway, let's enjoy managing food and cooking.

・ Advice from app creators!
I don't know ... but I am also enjoying using this app myself.
I'm playing with the setting that food is precious in a devastated future.
For now, I think the play style of "keeping a lot of ingredients that will last for a long time" is fun.
You can save the time of one meal.

・ Frozen and store cooked ingredients in small portions
・ Keep a lot of pickles in the refrigerator (the ingredients that have been around for a long time in your civilization may be interesting ...)
・ Research on how to eat dried fish as it has been for a long time (dry foods, Chinese foods are often undeveloped and seem to be interesting)
・ Store ingredients up to the point where you can maximize your refrigerator
・ Cooking with one of your favorite frying pans, one kitchen knife, and a clay pot (I think it's more fun to limit it)

Find your own play style and have fun.
com.kuwagata.sifi_fridge_2.descriptionShort: Enjoy food management as like survive in post apocalypse world.

com.app.soivyfi_135.descriptionHtml:
Why Choose Solvyfi?

🚀Quick and Satisfactory Answers: Provides the most satisfactory answer within 30 seconds of inquiry, ensuring swift resolutions to queries.

🚀Live Polling: Incorporates live polling features, fostering real-time engagement and interaction among users during the decision-making process.

🚀Objective Approach: Embraces an objective approach in addressing questions, allowing users to submit queries and choose from 2-6 objective answers they are uncertain about.

🚀Expert Involvement: Engages experts interested in specific user categories, enhancing the quality and relevance of responses in a particular field or category.

🚀High Accuracy: Achieves a remarkable 80% accuracy rate in answers, surpassing the standard polling accuracy of 65%.

🚀Swarm Intelligence: Utilizes swarm intelligence, leveraging collective expertise to empower individuals with highly informed answers sourced from a group of experts.

🚀AI-Driven Enhancement: Implements AI technologies to continuously enhance the quality and accuracy of solutions provided within the app.

🚀Accessibility: Available for all age groups, from children to elderly individuals, as long as they have access to a smartphone.

🚀User-Friendly Interface: Offers a simple user interface, enabling easy navigation and effortless input of queries and multiple-choice options.

🚀Efficient Problem-Solving: Facilitates users in resolving their doubts efficiently by enabling them to present their uncertainties and receive instant, well-informed answers from a collective expert pool. The answering mechanism unfolds over an approximate duration of a minute. During this time, participants traverse through a comprehensive loop encompassing selection, feedback, and modification stages, gradually converging towards a unanimous choice. This final option, arrived at by the collective consensus of the group, embodies Solvyfi's Answer.

🚀Engaging Answering Process: The answering process is entertaining and interactive, resembling a game-like tug of war. Users actively participate by pulling the ball towards their favored opinion. They can freely change their opinions throughout the process until the final moments of decision-making, adding excitement and engagement to the interaction.

Subsequently, the answered questions are presented to users in the form of tailored feeds aligned with their individual interests. The display of feeds is shown in a manner that incorporates a survey feature, enabling users to access the answer to any addressed question while preserving the engagement and interactivity within the platform.

eu.pitsnaider.chameleonradio_119.descriptionHtml:
Kurzbeschreibung für die App Chameleon:

Chameleon dient der Wiedergabe kostenfreier mp3-Streams aus dem Internet.
Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie ausreichend kostengünstiges Datenvolumen haben, oder nutzen Sie ein WLAN. In der App sind mehr als 400 Sender mit und ohne Werbung gespeichert.

Prämissen der App sind:

Nutzbar auf allen Androiden ab Version 4.1.

Einfache Bedienbarkeit der Grundfunktionen.

Keinerlei Zugriffe auf Nutzerbereiche, wie:
SD-Karte
Telefonspeicher / Telefonnummern
GPS, SMS, Mikrofon, Kamera

Keine Werbung durch die App.

Kein Datensammeln durch die App.

Beschränkung auf das Notwendigste: Radiohören, bei minimaler Programmgröße.

Automatisiertes Wiederverbinden nach einem Funkloch und bei Wechsel der Datenanbindung WLAN/EDGE/LTE.

Ist die App einfach bedienbar?

Ja, weil mit dem App- Start automatisch der zuletzt genutzte Sender startet und alternative Sender einfach zu nutzen sind. Die Bedienung ist der Bedienung eines realen Radiogerätes nachempfunden.

... und 'Nicht immer': Die geringe Anzahl der Bedienelemente erfordert deren Doppelbelegung. Für fortgeschrittene Nutzung ist somit das Lesen der Bedienungsanleitung vorteilhaft. Das Lesen von Bedienungsanleitungen ist halt immer schwierig.

Nachfolgend werden die Funktionen in der Reihenfolge ihrer Wichtigkeit erläutert.

Es gibt mehrere Bedienoberflächen:

Die App bietet die Oberflächen 'ECO' 'RETRO' 'MOBIL‘ 'POOR' und 'INFO'. Nicht jedes Gerät ist mit jeder der implementierten Bedienoberflächen gleich gut bedienbar.

Die Oberfläche ‚RETRO‘ wird gern für Tablets genutzt. (Design: UKW-Röhren-Radio).

Die Oberfläche 'POOR' bietet stets alle Tasten. (Design: puristisch)

Die Oberfläche ‚MOBIL‘ wird gern unterwegs genutzt. (Design: Player)

Die Oberfläche ‚INFO‘ bietet Hilfe und Informationen.

Einschalten:

Der zuletzt genutzte Sender wird automatisch gestartet.

Ausschalten:

Die Einstellungen zu Filtern, Favoriten und Sendern werden gespeichert.

Lang-Tippen startet einen Sleep-Timer.


Favoriten:

Legen Sie Favoriten unkompliziert mittels Doppeltipp auf die Stationstaste an.


Stumm-Schaltung/Mute und wieder Laut stellen:

Tippen im Bereich der Volumenanzeige.


Laut und Leise:

Die Lautstärke wird mit vertikalem Wischen oder einfach mit Tippen geregelt. Das geht ganz nebenbei ohne Feinmotorik.


Wiedergabe stoppen:

Tippen der Taste 'STOP'.


Wiedergabe pausieren/ fortsetzen:

Tippen der Taste 'PAUSE'.


Wiedergabe des letzten Senders starten:

Tippen Taste 'START' oder Lautstärke oder Senderstationstaste.


Senderwahl:

Das Tippen einer der 4 Senderstationstasten startet den angewählten Sender im Vordergrund.

Weitere Sender können temporär im Hintergrund laufen. Das dient dem schnellen Wechsel beim Zappen.


Orientierung der App (Anzeige Portrait/Landschaft oder auch Hochkant/Quer):

Im Standard erfolgt die Steuerung mit den Sensoren des Smartphones/Tablets. Ggf. wollen Sie die App nicht automatisch gedreht haben, dann kann die Steuerung mittels Wischgesten in der App erfolgen.


Akku Sparen:

Tippen Taste 'SPTI' (Sparen/ Ttelanzeige).

Der Bildschirm wird abgedunkelt, der Prozessor etwas weniger beansprucht.
Langes Tipen- Titelanzeige- Auch für ältere Geräte- Akku und Datenvolumen sparend auf Abfrage.

Filter setzen:

Die Filtertasten zu Genre, Sprache, Kontinent, Land und Bandbreite ermöglichen das schnellere Auffinden eines interessierenden Senders. Die Filter können parallel eingesetzt werden.


Werbung:

Einige Sender finanzieren sich durch Werbung. Die Werbung wird in keiner Weise durch die App gesteuert.

Die App wird nicht werbefinanziert. Das Ausstellen der Werbung ist nicht möglich.


Senderpflege und individuelle Belegung:

Die gespeicherten Sender werden sporadisch mittels App-Update aus dem Playstore, ohne Garantie auf Vollständigkeit, gepflegt.

Die Senderpflege kann darüber hinaus individuell durch den Benutzer erfolgen.

Wir wünschen Allzeit guten Empfang

com.mobincube.diccionario_griego_biblico.descriptionHtml:
Diccionario griego bíblico es una herramienta para aprender de una manera fácil y sencilla las características del griego bíblico. Con un sencillo menú accederás a todas las fichas con las definiciones de las palabras ordenadas alfabéticamente. Incluye buscador para fácil acceso.

Te ofrecemos un diccionario griego, geografía griega, cultura griega... todo a golpe de click, de una manera sencilla que te ayudará a aprender más fácilmente la Biblia y la cultura griega.

El conocer el origen y sentido de las palabras bíblicas, es una faceta crucial en la comprensión del significado verdadero de la Sagrada Escritura.

El griego (en griego, Ελληνική γλώσσα [eliniˈci ˈɣlosa] o ελληνικά [eliniˈka]) es una lengua originaria de Grecia, que pertenece a la rama griega de las lenguas indoeuropeas.

Es la lengua indoeuropea con la mayor historia documentada, puesto que cuenta con más de 3400 años de evidencia escrita. El sistema de escritura que ha utilizado durante la mayor parte de su historia y hasta la actualidad es el alfabeto griego. Previamente utilizó otros sistemas, como el Lineal B o el silabario chipriota. El alfabeto griego deriva del fenicio, y a su vez dio lugar a los alfabetos latino, cirílico y copto, entre otros.

Refleja lo más importante del léxico de todos los autores literarios y textos documentales desde la época micénica hasta el final de la Antigüedad, aprovechando la más reciente bibliografía sobre lexicografía, lexicología, semántica, lingüística y etimología del griego antiguo.

El griego ocupa un lugar importante dentro de la Historia de Europa, la llamada civilización occidental y la cristiandad.

La mayor parte de La Biblia se escribió en dos lenguas: hebreo y griego. Sus escritores utilizaron esos idiomas guiados por el espíritu santo de Dios (2 Samuel 23:2). Por eso, se puede decir que es “inspirada de Dios” (2 Timoteo 3:16, 17).

Ampliar el conocimiento sobre numerosas definiciones griegas puede ayudar a mejorar su conocimiento de la Biblia.

Descarga ahora diccionario griego bíblico y aprende nuevas e interesantes definiciones.

Diccionario griego bíblico incluye los siguientes recursos para un mejor estudio y una mejor comprensión:

- Alfabeto griego
- Diccionario Griego-español online
- Biblia Escrita
- Biblia griega en audio
- Antiguo Testamento Griego
- Nuevo Testamento Griego
- NT Audio
- Codex Sinaiticus
- Codex Bezae
- Traductor
- Gramática griega
- Mapas históricos

Te ofrecemos de manera gratuita más aplicaciones de temáticas muy interesantes dentro de la app como Diccionario Bíblico en español, oraciones católicas, y Frases de la Biblia.

En este sitio se usan identificadores de dispositivo para personalizar el contenido y los anuncios, con el fin de ofrecer anuncios de medios y para analizar el tráfico. App Disguise: The app uses a real Calculator as the icon so that nobody will know it's a Calculator hide app. Even the name shows as just Calculator!

Secure Vault: Lock away pictures and videos from your gallery and file manager that you don’t want anyone to see with zero size restrictions, and unlimited files behind a PIN. You can even take new photos and videos directly in the app for added locker protection!

Integrated Player: With a built-in photo viewer and video player, you can browse the hidden files directly in the app for added protection. Our video player allows you to adjust the volume, and skip ahead to any part of the video you want to see. Multiple file formats are supported: jpg, png, gif, mov, mp4, and more.

Multiple Folders: You can create an unlimited amount of folders to organize your photos and videos. You can also sort by file name or file size.

Multi-Select: You can select multiple media files from your gallery and import them all at once, or one at a time, which will save a lot of time securing your files.

Share Files: You can share any photo, video, or audio file directly from the Vault. This will allow you to keep your private memories locked while still allowing you to send them to your friends.

Real Calculator: Our app uses a working scientific calculator so that if one of your friends or family members opens the app they will think it’s just a normal calculator.

—-- FAQ —--

How do you open the Photo Vault?
Enter in your PIN that you typed in during the setup. The vault will automatically unlock when the PIN is entered.

What happens if I forget my PIN?
During setup, you will be asked to set a Security Question. If you forget your PIN just open the app and find the ? mark icon on the top left on the Calculator screen, then enter in the answer to the Security Question. If you forgot your Security Answer, be sure to contact us for further help.

Are my files stored online?
No, your files are only stored on-device. Be sure to backup your phone and app data before transferring to another device or starting a factory reset.

How do I restore my files?
To restore your files, open the app, then unlock the Vault. Then tap on the Top left and open Settings. Here you will be able to restore your files back into the Vault. The exact instructions are: Settings > Backup & Restore > Tap Restore

Is it possible to change my PIN?
Yes, you can change your PIN in the Settings page found after you have opened the Vault. You will see a “Change Calculator PIN” option.

Can I backup my files to an external SD card?
Yes, you can backup your files to an external storage by going to Settings > Backup & Restore > Backup. Your files can then be moved to an external storage.

Need more help?
If you are having any problems with Calculator Photo:Video Vault, feel free to contact us by sending an email to: support@safemeapps.com

IMPORTANT
Your privacy is very important to us. We want to be absolutely clear that we do not keep a copy or store your files on any servers. All of your files are stored locally on your device.

03 나누면 기쁨 두 배, 친구초대!
친구 초대하고 할인쿠폰, 적립금 등 다양한 혜택을 챙기세요.
초대받은 친구 역시 추천인을 입력하면 혜택을 받을 수 있어 1석 2조! 좋은 건 나누세요~

04 알아서 찾아주는 간편리뷰기능!
구매한 상품이 있다면? 몇 번의 터치만으로 간단하게 리뷰 작성하고 혜택을 챙기세요~.
구매했던 상품을 일일이 찾을 필요 없이 앱에 접속하면 자동으로 뜨는 간편리뷰 기능으로 편리함을 더했습니다.

■ 앱 접근 권한에 대한 안내

「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」제22조의2에 따라 아래와 같은 목적으로 ‘앱 접근 권한’에 대한 동의를 이용자에게 받고 있습니다.
서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있습니다.
선택적 접근의 항목은 허용하지 않더라도 서비스의 이용이 가능하며 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.

[필수접근에 대한 내용]

1. 안드로이드 6.0 이상

● 전화 : 최초 실행시, 디바이스 식별을 위하여 이 기능에 접근합니다.
● 저장 : 게시글 작성시 파일 업로드, 하단버튼 및 푸시 이미지 표현을 하고자 할 경우에 이 기능에 접근합니다.

[선택접근에 대한 내용]

- 매장 근처 푸시 기능이 있는 경우 아래 위치 권한을 포함하고 있습니다.

● 위치 : 고객위치를 확인하여 상점의 유효한 정보를 전달하기 위해 접근합니다.

[철회 방법]
설정 > 앱 또는 어플리케이션 > 해당 앱 선택 > 권한 선택 > 접근권한 동의 또는 철회 선택

※ 단 필수접근의 대한 내용을 철회 한 후 다시 앱을 실행을 할 경우 접근권한을 요청하는 화면이 다시 나오게 됩니다.

2. 안드로이드 6.0 미만

● 기기 ID 및 통화 정보 : 최초 실행시, 디바이스 식별을 위하여 이 기능에 접근합니다.

- 매장 근처 푸시 기능이 있는 경우 아래 위치 권한을 포함하고 있습니다.

※ 버전에 따라 동일한 접근 내용임에도 불구하고, 그 표현을 다르게 하고 있음을 알려드립니다.
※ 안드로이드 6.0 미만 버전의 경우, 항목에 대한 개별동의가 불가능하므로, 모든 항목에 대하여 필수 접근 동의를 받고 있습니다.
그러므로 사용하고 있는 단말기의 운영체제를 안드로이드 6.0 이상으로 업그레이드 할 수 있는지 확인 하시고 업그레이드를 권장하여 드립니다.
다만, 운영체제가 업그레이드되더라도 기존 앱에서 동의한 접근 권한이 바뀌지 않기 때문에 접근 권한을 다시 설정하기 위해서는 이미 설치한 앱을 삭제한 후에 재설치하셔야 합니다.

Do you use LINE app? Do you have a Samsung smart watch? This could be an app for you!

Please support this app with the donate version: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mysticwind.linenotificationsupport.donate

Do you complain about your Samsung smart watch not showing the LINE messages the way you want?
* Only the last messages are being shown?
* You're not being notified when there is a LINE call?

This is the app for you!

Features:
* Shows the message history (even if you don't have a watch, you can read the messages without the them being marked as read!). Please note that you won't have access to the message history after responding or dismissing the messages. This feature is to address LINE "only" showing the latest message.
* Grouping of messages. Chats from groups and those from individuals will be separated out. You don't have to filter those messages in your brain!
* You'll get messages when you get an incoming call. Worried that you may not get it? It will send messages continuously until you accept or reject.
* You can configure each chat the way you want! You can choose to ignore notifications that come from some to focus on the critical messages!
* LINE stickers will also be shown on your watch!
* You CAN reply to your friends on your watch!
* Disable Bluetooth during ongoing calls - workaround to address a low volume bug when connected to Samsung watches.

Supports all LINE languages (the app still has limited language support though - translation contributions are always welcomed).

Uses permissions:
* Internet: this is to download LINE stickers
* Notification access: this is to read notifications from LINE so that it can resend the notifications in the right format

tamil.manthirangal_9.descriptionHtml:
ஓம் என்னும் மந்திரத்திற்கு பல விளக்கங்கள் உள்ளன. ஆதிபகவானாகிய இறைவனே! ஜீவனாகிய என்னை சேர்த்துக்கொள், என்பது இதன் பொருள். ஒவ்வொரு தடவையும் ஓம் என்று சொன்ன பிறகு, விஷ்ணுவே, சிவனே, சக்தியே, விநாயகா, ஐயப்பா, முருகா என்றெல்லாம் அவரவர் இஷ்டதெய்வத்தை அழைக்கிறோம்.

ஓம் முருகா, ஓம் விநாயகா, ஓம் விஷ்ணு, ஓம் சிவாயநம என்று சொல்லும் போது, அந்தந்த தெய்வங்களிடம் என்னை உன்னோடு சேர்த்துக்கொள் என்று பொருள் தெரிந்தோ, தெரியாமலோ கெஞ்சுகிறோம். காலம் வரும்போது, இந்த மந்திரம் சொன்னதற்குரிய பலன் உறுதியாகக் கிடைக்கும். பிறப்பற்ற நிலையும் பரமானந்தமும் ஏற்படும்.
ஓம் என்னும் மந்திரத்திற்குள் சிருஷ்டி கர்த்தாவான பிரம்மாவும்,, காக்கும் கடவுளான விஷ்ணுவும்,சம்ஹார மூர்த்தியாகிய ருத்திரனும் அடக்கம்.ஓம் என்னும் மந்திரம் ஜபிப்பதன் மூலம் உடலையும் உள்ளத்தையும் சீராக வைத்துக்கொள்ள முடியும்.

எடுத்த நியாயமான கோரிக்கைகள் நிறைவேறும்.எதிர்ப்பு சக்திகள் நீங்கும்.மன சாந்தி ஏற்படும்.உலகத்தோடு ஒட்டி வாழலாம்,வயது முதிர்ந்தோர் இந்த ஏகாட்சரத்தால் ஏகாந்த நிலையை அடையலாம். வாய்விட்டு ஜபிக்காமல் மனதிற்குள் “ஒம்”, “ஓம்”, “ஓம்” என ஜபிக்க வேண்டும். இல்லாவிட்டால் ஓ. . . ம் என நீட்டியும் மனதால் ஜபிக்கலாம்.
கிழக்குப் பார்க்க அமர்ந்து கண்களை மூடி ஜெபிப்பது நன்று.மாடி வீட்டில் இருந்து ஜபித்தால் பலன் கூடும்.மலை மேல் இருந்து ஜெபித்தால் பல மடங்கு சக்தி கிடைக்கும்.எந்த மந்திரம் ஜபிக்க ஆரம்பித்தாலும்,குறைந்தது ஒரு லட்சம் உரு ஏற்றியபின் தான் பலன் கிடைக்க ஆரம்பிக்கும்.உங்கள் உடலின் மின்சக்தி மற்றும் காந்த சக்தி ஏற்படும். வியாதியஸ்தர் முன் ஜெபித்தால் அவர்களின் நோய் நீங்கும்.

வேப்பங்குச்சியால் குழந்தைகள் நாக்கில் “ஓம்” என எழுத அவர்கள் கல்வி மேம்படும்.சுத்தமான பசுஞ்சாண விபூதியில் “ஓம்” என எழுதிக்கொடுக்க வயிற்று நோய்கள் நீங்கும். ஒரு எலக்ட்ரானிக் எலக்ட்ரோ மீட்டர் மூலமாக சாதாரண மனிதனின் மின் சக்தியை அளக்க வேண்டும்.
பின் ஒம் ஓம் ஒம் என்று ஒரு லட்சம் முறை ஜபித்தவரின் மின்சக்தியை அளக்க வேண்டும்.அப்போது இருவருக்குமுள்ள வேறுபாடு நன்கு தெரியும். வாகனம் ஓட்டும்போதும், தெருவில் நடக்கும்போதும் எந்த மந்திரமும் ஜபிக்கக் கூடாது.

com.freemium.android.apps.skipal_440.creator: Mystic Mobile Apps GPS Tools
com.freemium.android.apps.skipal_440.descriptionHtml:
This app allows you to track every inch/centimeter of all your skiing adventures!

📍 Real-Time Location Insights: Stay informed on-the-go with SkiPal's up-to-the-minute location data, ensuring you never lose your way.

📊 Comprehensive Trip Analysis: Dive deep into your skiing statistics with detailed trip measurements, capturing every moment of your exhilarating experience.

🗺 Visualized Routes on Maps: Relive your skiing journey with routes artistically drawn over maps, showcasing every twist and turn of your adventure.

🏂 Versatile Activity Selection: Whether you're skiing or snowboarding, SkiPal tailors its features to your chosen snow sport for a customized experience.

📈 In-Depth Ski Metrics: Track your ski distance, maximum speed, and calories burned, turning every ski trip into a measurable adventure.

📉 Dynamic Data Charts: Uncover patterns in your performance with various charts displaying elevation, speed, and more, over time.

🆘 SOS Rescue Feature: Ski with peace of mind knowing the SOS rescue message feature is there to keep you safe in emergencies.

📸 Enhanced Trip Photography: Capture breathtaking photos with overlaid trip data and pinpoint their exact locations on a map for a unique storytelling experience.

📍 Customizable Waypoints: Personalize your ski map with waypoints, marking important locations and data for a more organized adventure.

⏱ Quick Ride Launch: Instantly start a new ride and track its duration with SkiPal's quick ride feature, perfect for spontaneous skiing sessions.

📔 Historical Trip Archive: Look back on your skiing milestones with easy access to historical trip data, creating a legacy of your snowy escapades.

🔄 Versatile Data Export and Import: Flexibly export your trips to GPX, KML, KMZ formats, and import GPX data for a seamless data management experience.

🗺️ Offline Map Accessibility: Navigate confidently without internet connection using SkiPal's offline map downloads, ensuring uninterrupted ski adventures.

🔍 Segmented Trip Analysis: Dissect your trip into uphill and downhill segments, offering detailed insights into every aspect of your skiing experience.

☁️ Cloud Sync and Web Panel Access: Log in to synchronize your data across devices and access it through a convenient web panel for comprehensive trip management.

🔉 Motivational Audio Cues: Stay motivated and informed with audio cues that activate after specific time intervals or distances traveled, keeping you engaged throughout your ski trip.

⌚ Wear OS Integration: Enjoy the freedom of measuring your ski trips with Wear OS compatibility, enhancing your experience with hands-free convenience.

Simply tap or move your finger over the chart to see when and where a given value occurred. You can also choose from multiple snowbound activities, the app will function as a speedometer, calorie counter, keep track of checkpoint times, alert you with notification sounds at pre-set milestones, and even auto pause should you decide to stop somewhere for coffee or to take a photo. If you do stop to take photos, they can easily be added with the data of your current position overplayed right on top. Your photos will have- elevation, average speed, location and even route info right on them.

New maps based on Open Street Maps have been added to the application. You can now enjoy a fresh new look to your tracks, with certain ski resort routes being displayed on them. com.minimiew.kamkomsawaddee_9.descriptionHtml:
สวัสดีตามวัน ใหม่ทุกวัน2021 ทักทายยามเช้า ส่งความห่วงใยคิดถึงให้แก่กัน คุณสามารถใช้ส่งภาพสวัสดีตามวัน แต่ละวัน ตั้งแต่วันจันทร์ ถึง วันอาทิตย์ มีครบทุก 7 วัน (good morning 7 day) เป็นการให้กำลังใจกันในทุกๆวัน มีทั้ง รูปสวัสดีตามวัน อรุณสวัสดิ์ยามเช้าแบบใหม่ล่าสุด ให้คนที่คุณรักรู้สึกอบอุ่น และมีกำลังใจในทุกวัน ส่งความปรารถนาดี ให้กันได้ทุกเวลาผ่านทางโซเชียล นอกจากนี้ยังได้ทำการอัพเดท ภาพสวัสดีตามวัน ตลอดทุกสัปดาห์ ไม่มีซ้ำกัน

คําคมสวัสดีตอนเช้า ขอเป็นตัวแทนในการเป็นสื่อกลางให้ทุกคนได้ส่งความห่วงใยด้วย ภาพสวัสดีตอนเช้าใหม่ ๆ 2021 สามารถแชร์สวัสดีทุกวันทุกเวลา ใช้งานสะดวก ไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายใดๆ รูปสวัสดีตามวัน สร้างสรรค์ด้วยความสวยงาม พร้อมคำอวยพร คําคมสวัสดีตามวัน คำคมให้กำลังใจ ข้อคิดดีๆ มากมาย ไม่ได้มีเพียงเท่านี้ยังมี ภาพดอกไม้สวยๆให้คุณได้ใช้งานแบบแน่นๆกันไปเลย

คุณสมบัติ
- สำหรับแชร์และส่งให้เพื่อนๆ แชร์เป็นภาพสวัสดีตามวันผ่านทางโซเชียล
- บันทึกไว้ในอัลบั้ม บันทึกไว้เป็นภาพในแกลอรี่ และเก็บคำคมที่คุณชื่นชอบไว้ในรายการโปรด
- อัพเดทข้อมูล สวัสดีตามวันอย่างต่อเนื่องทุกสัปดาห์ เพียงคุณเชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ต wifi หรือ 3G

ขอบคุณทุกท่าน อย่าลืมให้กำลังใจกันด้วยนะค่ะ ถ้าถูกใจท่านสามารถให้ 5 ดาว และหากมีข้อติ ชม หรือข้อเสนอแนะใดๆฝากคอมเมนต์ไว้ได้เลยค่ะ

com.golfboxdk_238.creator: GolfBox
com.golfboxdk_238.descriptionHtml:
The GolfBox application provides quick mobile access to the main GolfBox functions, as well as statistics on your rounds.

To use the application you must sign in using your login information from GolfBox.

Once you're inside you have access to:

BOOKING
Here Order time for golf accurately as you know it from GolfBox. The phone's GPS are fully exploited when locating available start times near you, or if you want to book a time when you approach the first tee.
Times have already been ordered, see My times and here you can change or cancel if you wish.

SCORECARD
Here you get the chance to take your scorecard around the course and hole for hole set your strokes. You can also lead scores of your fellow players and after round submitted scorecard electronically to GolfBox. If your club allows electronic scorecard reporting, where you and your marker just have to agree, then your disability adjusted immediately you say thank you for the game.

STATISTICS
Here you can follow your game development of eg 5, 10 or 20 rounds - See your average score, your score and best and worst round.

TOURNAMENT
Here you can see which tournaments you are registered for or participated in.
You can also follow live scoring in your own or another Danish club. Or follow LIVE on the PGA Tour or European Tour.
You can also find DGU Tournaments and see results from the tournaments you have participated in.

NEWS
News that you can read on your mobile. So you will not miss the latest news, even if you are on the go.

Enjoy.

com.silvertrac.mob_4058.descriptionHtml:
Silvertrac offers a simple, yet powerful security guard mobile app designed to streamline security enforcement operations, increase employee accountability & improve customer relationships. We offer robust features including customizable guard tours, real-time incident reporting, advanced parking management, employee time clocks, pass down notes, post orders, live GPS tracking and more.

This mobile app is built for officers in the field to report guard tour information such as security incidents, maintenance, and parking issues back to supervisors in real-time for immediate response. All info is submitted to the central issue monitor through our secure cloud-based system, allowing quick relaying of information from patrol companies to their clients.

Managers and supervisors are granted administrative access to the issue monitor for full visibility into their operation. They can track officer movement, view detailed daily activity reports, and gauge employee performance to account for all officer activity.

Monthly subscription required for access. Please contact our Sales team for more information at (888) 505-8722 ext. 3 or visit https://www.silvertracsoftware.com

com.goder.busquerysystembeta_587.descriptionHtml:
本APP提供全台灣公車及客運路線和台北捷運及桃園/高雄捷運路線查詢
幾個主要功能說明如下:

*特有功能
- 可指定車牌,看該公車全程各站的到站時間預測,讓您隨時追踪公車何時會到哪一站
- 火車支線轉乘,一次查詢,不須分段,目前多數APP都沒有的功能,例如:可直接查台北-平溪,APP將提供您最適當的轉乘班次及轉乘車站
- 串連全台灣公車/客運/火車/捷運詳細轉乘資訊
- 發車預測: 沒有固定班表的公車,在未發車時,透過歷史資料,預測總站下一班車何時發車,即使在總站附近的站牌也可知道下班車何時來,目前其它同類型APP只會顯示未發車
- 靜態時刻表: 有固定班表的公車,提供現在及未來每一站公車預估抵達時間,方便您事先規劃行程
- 行車時間估計: 顯示上車到下車要花多少時間,讓您先做好準備
- 背景服務: 額外提供背景查詢服務(常用站牌/公車追踪/到站提醒/...),即使關閉APP 也可隨時查詢公車動態,不影響目前正在操作的前景APP(例如:正在瀏覽網頁)
- 腳踏車租借站即時資訊
- 提供多種站牌顯示樣式(直式/橫式,字型大小),可隨個人喜愛變換使用


1. 支援中文和英文操作界面切換

2. 最近一班公車
- 按一下就立刻知道哪一班公車要來了 完全不用其它操作
- 提供公車抵達附近站牌的時間,依最接近的時間先後排序
- 提供附近所有站牌在地圖中的地理位置,並可再地圖中點選特定站牌,查看所有經過該站的公車到站時間
- 可點選特定路線, 查詢該路線的所有站牌時間,若再選特定站牌,可查詢那個公車站附近的美食,餐廳,景點等商店資訊,讓你在坐公車或等公車時不無聊

3. 附近站牌
- 提供公車抵達附近站牌的時間,依站牌距離排序
- 提供附近所有站牌在地圖中的地理位置,並可點選特定站牌,查看公車到站時間
- 可點選特定站牌 在地圖中顯示與目前位置的步行路線
- 可點選特定路線, 查詢該路線的所有站牌到站時間

4. 路線查詢
- 提供輸入特定路線號碼,查詢指定路線的所有站牌到站時間
- 輸入站牌關鍵字就可查詢經過站牌的公車路線
- 點選路線中的特定站牌,可查詢那個公車站附近的食衣住行商店資訊
- 提供站牌地圖 顯示所有站牌的地理位置
- 提供台北捷運及桃園捷運路線查詢,及行車時間
- 自動記錄常查的路線號碼, 再次查詢時直接點選即可

5. 路線規劃
- 提供指定起點(預設目前位置)到終點之間的交通路線建議(步行,搭公車,搭捷運,搭火車等)
- 提供規劃好的路線地圖, 並標示所需使用的交通工具
- 可用語音輸入直接說出起點到終點,加快查詢速度
- 可點選終點位置,查詢目的地附近的美食,餐廳,景點等商店資訊
- 分享功能可將規劃好的路線分享給朋友(Line)或EMAIL或儲存下來

6. 附近食衣住行育樂商店查詢
- 提供目前位置附近的食衣住行育樂商店資訊
- 可查詢的商店類別有美食小吃,咖啡點心,餐廳,捷運站,YouBike,測速照相地點,火車站,景點,醫院,超商,美容美髮,旅館,服飾店,酒吧,鞋店,電影院,購物中心,加油站,學校,花店,電器行,藥局,銀行,旅行社,書局,郵局,自行車行,汽機車行,家俱行,房屋仲介,寵物店,水族館等,多達30幾種
- 可用語音輸入查詢特定的商店,例如:麥當勞, 星巴克,...
- 提供商店的詳細資訊,包括: 照片(可瀏覽),評分,地址,網址,營業時間,評論等
- 可設定搜尋半徑範圍(500公尺,1公里,2公里...)
- 提供商店地圖及街景,並顯示與目前位置的最佳交通路線(步行或搭車)
- 提供測速照相機偵測功能 啟用後 若偵測範圍內有測速照相機 將會自動提醒(啟用測速照相偵測功能會多耗一點點電力 不使用時請關閉)
- 可查詢全世界各地的城市或景點附近的商店資訊
- 分享功能可將查到的商店資訊分享給朋友(Line)或EMAIL或儲存下來

7. 台鐵火車/高鐵時刻表查詢
- 提供查詢台鐵及高鐵時刻表

com.uvdevloper.uvtechsoft.fabricationtoo.descriptionHtml:
This application useful for your all fabrication calculation , layouts , marking and all other fabrication activity.

It is very helpful for developing fabrication layout of all types of shapes generally used in fabrication. By this application you can save time , save cost , increase accuracy.

This app is mostly useful for who are fabricate, pressure vessel, heat exchanger, column, reboiler, Condensor, Heater, Boiler, Storage tank, Receiver, Heavy engineering, Heavy equipment fabrication, Reactor, Agitator, Structure, Ducting, Insulation cladding, Food industry equipment, Dairy equipment, Pharma equipment - Rotto Cone vaccum dryer, Vaccum tray dryer, Nutsche filter, Agitated Nutsche filter dryer, Other all typer of dryer, Other all types of Filter, Petrochemical - Oil and Gas refinery equipment, Chemical equipment. This app also use for that person who working as a Design engineer , QC Engineer , Production and Planing Engineer , Worker , fitter , welder , Draughstman , Company owner , Marketing engineer , Head of all respective department.


This app contains below items. Detail of app function described below

1) Weight Calculator :
-> All shapes weight and cost calculate. All type of shapes like plate, pipe, ring, circle, round bar, rectangular bar, square bar, triangular bar, C-section, T-section, I-section and Angle.

2) Dish blank dia calculator :
-> You can find All types of dish blank dia , dish height , knuckle radius , crown radius.

3) Nozzle pipe & flange marking :
-> Flange hole marking ,
-> Find dimension of Nozzle orientation ,
-> Get max and min. height of straight , offcenter/tangential , inclined nozzle setup on shell as well as straight nozzle setup on dish.

4) Pipe & Pipe Branch Layouts :
-> Shell development ,
-> Pipe to pipe joint Layout ,
-> Y-connection layout ,
-> Inclined / Lateral pipe layout ,
-> Off-center / Tangential pipe layout
-> Pipe cut one and both end layout.

5) Cone layout :
-> Concentric frustum cone development : user can define no of long-seam value , user can also get plat size for more than 1 segment of cone.
-> Find slant height and OD at specific height of cone,
-> Multi-joint frustum cone development : user can define height of multi-joint section
-> Roof type cone development ,
-> Eccentric cone development,
-> Rectangular to round cone layout ,
-> Concentric Square / Rectangular cone layout ,
-> Eccentric Square / Rectangular cone layout ,


6) Miter-bend Layouts :
-> You can get any number of part miter bend layout.

7) Ring/Flange segment layouts :

-> Single Ring/Flange segment marking
-> More than 1 Ring/Flange segment marking : user can get plat size also.
-> Find ring/flange segment angle by entering width of plate. Segment either arrange horizontal or vertical


8) Surface area calculator :
-> All shapes of surface area calculate.

9) Volume calculator :
-> Volume calculation of Shell/Pipe , All types of Dish , Frustum cone , Roof cone , Square / rectangular tank , Square cone
-> Combine volume of Shell + Dish +

10) Heat exchanger :
-> You can find number pf tube arrange in tubesheet
-> Find Heat transfer area , number pf tube , tube length.

11) Coil length & Coil marking :
-> Find Helical coil length and limpet coil length.
-> Marking of single start and double start limpet coil on dish.

12) Spiral stiffner development :
-> Spiral stiifner setup inside jacket you can get its development easily. Also you can use for screw conveyor blade.

13) Bodyflange development :
-> Find bodyflange development length its weight and costing.

com.manhajona.OmarAbdelkafy_1005.descriptionHtml:
محاضرات وخطب بصوت الشيخ عمر عبد الكافي بدون نت، وأكثر من 700 محاضرة بجودة عالية

عمر عبد الكافي .. شيخ الوسطية والاعتدال

نجم من نجوم البعث الحضاري، ومَثـل يُحتذى به في المنهج الوسطي للإسلام. أحبَّ الأرض فتعلم الزراعة، وعشِق السماء فدَرَسَ العلوم الشرعية. نال أرقى الشواهد والدبلومات، وحصل على التكريم والتشريفات. عمل على زراعة بذور القمح في مزارع الأرض فلم يعجبه حرث الدنيا، وزرع بذور الخير في مزارع القلوب فاطمأنت نفسه لحرث الآخرة، نَقَلَ معارفه من خلال الخطابة والتدريس، ودعا إلى الله بالكلمة الطيبة والنصح الحسن، فسَجَّل نجاحا باهرا في المساجد والملتقيات، وحقق أقوى المتابعات على الفضائيات، له مئات الخطب والتسجيلات، وفي رصيده مثلها من الكتب والإصدارات. إنه الداعية الإسلامي المصري عمر عبد الكافي، واسمه الكامل عمر عبد الكافي شحاتة.

وُلِد الشيخ عمر عبد الكافي في فاتح ماي سنة 1951، في محافظة "المنيا" بجمهورية مصر العربية، لعائلة محافظة ذات مَحْتِد وأصْل. فقد كان والده من الأعيان في صعيد مصر، وكانت أمه حافظة لجزء كبير من كتاب الله. فتلقى منهما تربية دينية صالحة، غرست في نفسه مكارم الأخلاق، وزرعت في قلبه حب الله وكتابه، وعشق النبي وسـنته.

ومنذ نعومة أظافره، أظهر الشيخ عمر عبد الكافي نبوغا فكريا حادا، وذكاء فطريا مُتَّقِدا، بعدما تَمَكّنَ، وهو في العاشرة من عمره، من حفظ القرآن الكريم وصحيحيْ البخاري ومسلم، ونجح في اجتياز مختلف المراحل التعليمية بامتياز.

ru.edpankov.transistors_3.creator: Эдуард Паньков
ru.edpankov.transistors_3.descriptionHtml:
The directory contains all the main categories of transistors: bipolar silicon and germanium transistors, pre-biased bipolar transistors, junction and metal-oxide-semiconductor field effect transistors (MOSFET), insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBT). There are also transistor assemblies: dual bipolar transistor, dual pre-biased bipolar transistors, dual-channel mos-field effect transistors (MOSFET) and dual-channel insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBT).
The directory provides two ways to search for transistors in the database - by parameters and by name. Search by name is convenient if you have a transistor and need to find out its characteristics. To do this, you need to type characters from the name of the transistor, while the table below will immediately display those transistors, in the name of which there is this sequence of characters.
To search for parameters, first select the appropriate category of transistors. Then you specify the ranges of values of the necessary parameters for the selected type of transistors. Transistors that meet the specified parameters will also be displayed in the table below.
By clicking on one of the lines, you can open a page with a detailed description of the selected transistor. In the description, in addition to the parameters for selection, all the parameters of the transistor from the reference database will be presented. In addition, the following suggested replacement for this transistor and other transistors, the main parameters of which are not worse or slightly better.

Hastane, okul, iş yeri konumuna göre arama yapabilirsiniz. İlan sahibiyle whatsapp iletişimi kurabilir daha fazla ayrıntıya sahip olabilirsin, hemen ara seçeneği ile direkt olarak telefon görüşmesi sağlayabilirsiniz, hayalinize ulaşmak tek tık kadar kolay.

İlan verin, milyonlarca kişiye ulaşın!
İlanlarınızın doğru kitleye ulaşması emlaksitem ile mümkün. Hızlıca kiralama, satış gibi emlak işleriniz için doğru yerdesiniz. Milyonlarca kişinin ilgilendiği emlak sektöründe ilanınızın erişilebilir olması gerekiyor.

Alım, satım, kiralama işlerinizin yanı sıra; kat karşılığı arsa, markalı konut projeleri, tarım alanı alım-satım, çiftlik, yazlık, dağ evi kiralama gibi birçok alanda ilan verebilir ve erişebilirsiniz. Ev ilanınızın hak ettiği değeri görmesi, değerinde emlak ilanı emlaksitem’de.

Gelişmiş algoritmasıyla size en doğru ve en ayrıntılı emlak sonuçlarını verir; Konum üzerinde de filtrelemeleri yapabilirsiniz. Sahibinden ilanlar, kiralık ev, satışa hazır ev, mülk ilanına hızlı ve kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz. Herkesin ihtiyacına yönelik emlak ilanlarında; metrekare, oda sayısı, doğalgaz ısıtma, kat kaloriferi, güney cephe, kuzey cephe gibi birçok özellik ve filtreleme ile en doğru sonuca ulaşabilir veya ilanınızı ortaya çıkarabilirsiniz.

au.com.idfish.app_68.descriptionHtml:
iDfish is a smart device application that provides you with reliable and consistent data when you’re out in the field doing what you love best: fishing!


Quickly identify species, determine the regulated size limit (if applicable), assess eating quality, and check if it should be released due to its protection status. All this information can be obtained in less than 60 seconds, giving the fish the best possible chance of survival when returned to the water.


iDfish has the largest database of line-caught species for mobile applications in the world. All the images in the database are high-quality and high-resolution. The developers of iDfish™ have gone to great lengths to represent fish images as they appear when freshly caught and removed from the water—no tank or underwater photos, no photos of dead fish, and no illustrations.


Fish can change color, shape, and size for various reasons. To ensure accurate identification, we also provide different color phases of various species. This feature, coupled with species comparison information, makes this previously difficult task quick and easy.


The application works offline and does not require an internet connection to function. Any trip information recorded will automatically back up to your account when an internet connection is re-established.



A yearly subscription is available to receive updates on fish details, limits, closures, and almanac data.

IDFISH APP YEARLY SUBSCRIPTION:
The iDfish application is being updated on a daily basis. These updates include species additions, new colour phases, updates to limits and data and tide and almanac updates. As such there are ongoing costs associated with keeping the application running therefore the application is offered purely on a subscription basis. 12-month subscription, automatically renewed until cancelled $9.90/year. Please see our in app purchases for current subscription costs.

The first month is free when you download the app from the Google Play Store after which you will be charged a per-year subscription as described below.

Payment for the subscription is charged to your Play Store account 30 days after the confirmation of your subscription purchase.

AUTOMATIC-RENEWAL of subscription: Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your Google Play Store account will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal 24-hours prior to the end of the current period unless you change your subscription preferences in your account settings. You can manage your subscriptions through your Account settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

If you would like more information on any of the terms and conditions of the app please head to http://idfish.com.au/terms-and-conditions

COMPATIBILITY

com.Seabaa.Dual_1514.creator: Seabaa
com.Seabaa.Dual_1514.descriptionHtml:
Between people, across screens.

DUAL is a local multiplayer game where two players use their mobile devices to shoot from one screen to the other. It's easy to pick up and play any of the competitive or cooperative modes: DUEL, DEFLECT, and DEFEND.

Features:
+ Battle locally over WiFi or Bluetooth.
+ DUEL - Tilt your phone, dodge bullets, charge, and shoot your friends in this classic duel standoff.
+ DEFEND - Work together to defend the middle from an onslaught of attackers.
+ DEFLECT - Score goals by blasting, banking, and curving the ball from one screen to the other.
+ Only one person needs to have the full version unlocked to play DEFEND and DEFLECT with another player.
+ Collectable color sets unique to your device; unlock them all by playing against different people.
+ Single one-time in-app purchase to unlock the full game, and restore it on all your devices using the same account.
+ Stats, achievements, and leaderboards.

*Bluetooth support is a beta feature and not guaranteed to work with every device.

"Working together right next to each other really brings back the magic of couch gaming."
- Chris Carter, Destructoid

"...it's a really fun way to engage with another live human, up-close and personal."
- Rick Broida, CNET

"You play it with someone, anywhere, and it actually brings you closer together..."
- Chris Priestman, Kill Screen

"...sending bullets across to someone else’s phone as you sit opposite them has a curious sense of technological magic to it."
- Chris Charlton, Kaijupop

Quick Troubleshooting Guide:
+ Make sure your WiFi is enabled and both players are on the same WiFi network.
+ Use Manual IP Discovery from the WiFi lobby if unable to find each other when on the same WiFi network.
+ If you're having issues with Bluetooth, try pairing both devices from the Android device settings.
+ If your screen size is smaller than expected, make sure to measure and adjust it manually for BOTH players in the RESET screen.
+ To restore your purchase go to the Unlock screen and the purchase button will turn into a restore button.

Compass app - Accurate Compass Start your next adventure confidently using our Accurate Compass App, the ultimate tool for outdoor enthusiasts, travelers, and anyone needing precise directional guidance. 🧭

Our app provides crystal-clear navigation assistance, whether setting camp, exploring new trails, or navigating uncharted waters. Use reliable compass mobile app wherever you go.

Why Our Compass App is Essential for Every Explorer:
🧭 Unmatched Accuracy: Experience outstanding navigation with our Accurate Compass, which reliably points you in the right direction every time. Perfect for pinpointing the east direction, our compass ensures you never lose your way.
🧭 User-Friendly Interface: Our Compass Mobile app is designed with simplicity, allowing you to quickly retrieve North, South, West, and East direction along with vital latitude and longitude information.
🧭 Versatile Use Cases: From casual road trips to intense boating excursions, our compass app adapts to your needs, ensuring you have the right tools for any scenario.

Advanced Features to Enhance Your Navigation Experience:
🗺️ Compass Direction Camera: Navigate with precision using our innovative camera mode. This feature overlays compass directions over a live view, helping you visualize your path without taking photos.
🗺️ Digital and Standard Compass Modes: Whether you prefer a modern digital display or the classic touch of a standard compass, our app offers both, equipped with necessary correction mechanisms for top-notch accuracy.
🗺️ Weather Updates and Smart Insights: Stay prepared with weather forecasts and current location updates provided by our accurate compass. Plan with insights into upcoming conditions.

Seamless and Practical Navigation Tools:
🧭 Satellite Compass: Our satellite compass mobile app offers up-to-the-minute details for those who demand the most precise location instructions, enhancing your navigation experience.
🧭 Night Mode: Use our accurate compass app compass effortlessly at night with a specially designed dark mode that reduces glare and makes reading directions easy on the eyes.
🧭 Telescope Functionality: Incorporate a telescope view for enhanced measurement and better focus on distant objects, all within the digital compass interface.

Key Benefits of Our Digital Compass - Smart Compass App:
🌐 Extremely Precise Directions: Our digital compass mobile app is not just accurate; it’s exact, especially when finding the east direction or any of the four cardinal points.
🌐 Rich Functional Integration: Our compass app goes beyond simple direction finding with features like a level meter to assess surface levels and GPS capabilities.
🌐 Customizable Display Options: Switch between light and dark modes for comfort and visibility, no matter the time of day or night.

Ready to transform your device into the most reliable and accurate digital compass mobile app you’ve ever used? Download our Digital Compass App now and enter a world of secure exploration.

Whether tracking east direction or charting a new course, let our digital compass app lead the way to your next great adventure. Say goodbye to getting lost and hello to discovering more with our all-in-one navigation solution!

com.burakgon.netoptimizer_1386.creator: AppAzio
com.burakgon.netoptimizer_1386.descriptionHtml:
What is the benefit of Net Optimizer?
-Find & Connect the fastest DNS server based on your location & network.
-Improve web surfing speed with faster response time.
-Fix lag and reduce latency (ping time) on online games for better gaming experience.

Features
-Just one touch to find & connect fastest DNS server to optimize your connection.
-Automatically detect connection changes and optimize the network.
-Scan manually all DNS servers with one touch to see all details yourself.
-Works for both mobile data (3G/4G/5G) and WiFi connection
-Supported DNS Servers: Cloudflare, Level3, Verisign, Google, DNS Watch, Comodo Secure, OpenDNS, SafeDNS, OpenNIC, SmartViper, Dyn, FreeDNS, Alternate DNS, Yandex DNS, UncensoredDNS, puntCAT

How it works?
If you have a high-speed Internet connection but notice that your web browsing speed isn’t all that it’s cracked up to be, then your problem may lie in the DNS. By optimizing your device's DNS records, you can find the fastest routes for your data packets to take when traveling the Internet. It won’t boost to your download/upload speed, but in some cases it can result in quite a noticeable improvement in web browsing time.

At times, you may experience slow hiccups while trying to use the internet from your device. Sometimes, these problems can be attributed to your provider's DNS settings because your ISP may not always have the best DNS server speeds.

Your default DNS server directly affects how fast you’ll be able to connect to a website. So choosing the fastest server according to your location will help speed up browsing.

With Net Optimizer, you can find the fastest DNS server and connect to it with just one touch!
So your browsing speed and gaming experience (ping and latency) can be improved. (But you should remember that DNS settings will not affect your internet download / upload speed but response time)

Results
Test results showed a 132.1 percent improvement from using Google's DNS servers over using the stock DNS servers, but in real world usage, it might not be exactly that much faster. Still, this one tweak might get you finally feeling like you have a blazing connection to the internet!

Required Permissions And Privacy Notes

Overlay Permission: To show Auto Optimize pop-up, we ask for display over other apps permission.

VPNService: Net Optimizer uses VPNService base class to create DNS connection. When your Android device connects to the Internet from a specific network, your address on the Internet (the location of your Android device in the virtual network) is called the IP address. And the IP address is a code system consisting of encrypted numbers. Net Optimizer processes these numbers as site addresses by using DNS servers, and the address can be reached when searched in this way.

com.sensustech.acremotecontrol_14.descriptionHtml:
Agree how it is cool if you can control almost all the equipment in the house with the help of one of your smartphones or tablets! Remote control of a TV, a robotic vacuum cleaner or other smart appliances is no longer a surprise, but what about universal remote control of an air conditioner (AC)? Try our application and we will change the way you think about this technique!

Download our application based on Android right now and you can throw into the farthest box the standard remote controller from the air conditioner (AC), because our application is a new way to control your air conditioner. Use our app and forget about the classic remote control for your air conditioner.

The main thing is to remember that in order for our program to work correctly on your smartphone or tablet, you must have a built-in IR blaster transmitter or an external IR port, as on a standard air conditioner control panel. Together with our application, you can:

1) Turn your air conditioner on or off in general.
2) Choose the desired operating mode and intensity: cold, warm or ventilation, ceiling fan, and so on.
3) Adjust optimal temperature conditions.
4) Establish a working schedule for all your air conditioners in the house, so this function is especially important if you need to manage more than one device in one room.
5) Monitor the correct operation of the air conditioner and see an error code if it doesn't work correctly.

What air conditioners is our application compatible with?

You will definitely find your option from the list:

Lost your AC remote controller? No problem:

• Download our universal application right now, install and open it.
• Choose your brand of AC from the list of available ones and connect to it.
• Wait a little while your smartphone or tablet connects to the air conditioner.
• Follow the short instructions from the app.
• A few minutes, and that's it, you can control the air conditioner from your gadget!

What could be easier! Just a few minutes of setup and a universal remote control for your air conditioner is already in your pocket. Change the temperature, create a pleasant climate around you and enjoy the benefits of a smart life. And we will help you with this!
